# hubspot

## HUBSPOT_ADD_ASSET_ASSOCIATION
Associates an existing asset ('FORM', 'OBJECT_LIST', or 'EXTERNAL_WEB_URL') with a specified HubSpot marketing campaign.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddAssetAssociationRequest",
  "required": [
    "campaignGuid",
    "assetType",
    "assetId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "assetId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Asset Id",
      "examples": [
        "12345",
        "98765",
        "123456789"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the asset to be associated with the campaign. This ID is specific to the assetType. For FORMs, use the form's numeric ID. For OBJECT_LIST, use the list ID (ILS ID). For EMAIL, use the email's content ID. For LANDING_PAGE or BLOG_POST, use the page/post ID. These IDs can be obtained from HubSpot's UI (in the asset's URL or details panel) or by using the corresponding list/search actions for that asset type.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Asset ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique ID of the specific asset you want to link to the campaign. Find this ID in the asset's URL in HubSpot (e.g., forms show their ID in the form editor URL, lists show their ID in the list page URL) or retrieve it using a list/search action for that asset type."
    },
    "assetType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Asset Type",
      "examples": [
        "FORM",
        "OBJECT_LIST",
        "EXTERNAL_WEB_URL",
        "EMAIL",
        "LANDING_PAGE",
        "BLOG_POST"
      ],
      "description": "Type of asset to associate with the campaign. Commonly supported types include: 'FORM', 'OBJECT_LIST' (Static/Contact List), 'EXTERNAL_WEB_URL', 'EMAIL', 'LANDING_PAGE', 'BLOG_POST', 'CTA', 'WORKFLOW', 'SOCIAL_POST', 'WEBSITE_PAGE', 'SEQUENCE', 'MEETING_EVENT', 'PLAYBOOK', 'FEEDBACK_SURVEY', 'SALES_DOCUMENT'. HubSpot continues to expand asset type support over time.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Asset Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose the kind of asset you're linking (for example, FORM for forms, OBJECT_LIST for contact lists, EMAIL for emails, LANDING_PAGE for landing pages). The asset type determines what kind of content will be associated with the campaign."
    },
    "campaignGuid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Campaign Guid",
      "examples": [
        "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier (UUID) of the HubSpot campaign to which the asset will be associated.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Campaign ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique ID of the HubSpot campaign you want to add the asset to. This tells us which campaign to update."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for associating an asset with a HubSpot marketing campaign."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_ADD_TOKEN_TO_EVENT_TEMPLATE
Adds a new custom data token to an existing event template for a specified HubSpot application, optionally populating a CRM object property if objectPropertyName is provided.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "AddTokenToEventTemplateRequest",
  "required": [
    "eventTemplateId",
    "appId",
    "name",
    "label",
    "type"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "deal_stage_id",
        "customer_feedback_score",
        "order_details_url"
      ],
      "description": "The internal name of the token, used for referencing it within templates. Must be unique for this event template. Allowed characters: alphanumeric, periods (.), dashes (-), or underscores (_).",
      "human_parameter_description": "A short, unique internal name you\u2019ll use to reference this token in templates or integrations. Use letters, numbers, dots, dashes, or underscores."
    },
    "type": {
      "enum": [
        "date",
        "enumeration",
        "number",
        "string"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Type",
      "examples": [
        "string",
        "number",
        "date",
        "enumeration"
      ],
      "description": "The data type of the token. Determines how the token's value is stored and validated.",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose how the token's value should be stored (text, number, date, or a set of choices). This controls validation and how it can be used."
    },
    "appId": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "App Id",
      "examples": [
        12345,
        67890
      ],
      "description": "Numeric identifier of the target application associated with the event template. Provided in the URL path.",
      "human_parameter_name": "App ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of your HubSpot app that owns the event template. This ensures the token is added to the correct app."
    },
    "label": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Label",
      "examples": [
        "Deal Stage",
        "Customer Feedback Score",
        "Order Details URL"
      ],
      "description": "The user-facing label for the token. This label is used for list segmentation and in reporting.",
      "human_parameter_description": "The friendly name people will see in lists and reports. Make it clear and descriptive."
    },
    "options": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "OptionsRequest",
        "required": [
          "label",
          "value"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "label": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Label",
            "examples": [
              "Open",
              "In Progress",
              "Closed"
            ],
            "description": "The user-facing display text for this option.",
            "human_parameter_description": "The text people will see for this choice in dropdowns or lists. Make it clear and easy to understand."
          },
          "value": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Value",
            "examples": [
              "open",
              "in_progress",
              "closed"
            ],
            "description": "The internal programmatic value associated with this option.",
            "human_parameter_description": "A simple code that represents this choice behind the scenes. Use a clean, consistent value (for example, lowercase with no spaces)."
          }
        },
        "description": "Represents a single choice in an enumeration token, consisting of a display label and an internal value."
      },
      "title": "Options",
      "examples": [
        "[{\"label\": \"High Priority\", \"value\": \"high_priority\"}, {\"label\": \"Medium Priority\", \"value\": \"medium_priority\"}]"
      ],
      "description": "A list of options for the token, required and applicable only if the token `type` is 'enumeration'. Each option must have a 'label' and a 'value'.",
      "human_parameter_description": "Provide a list of choices only if type is 'enumeration'. Each choice should include a label people see and a value used internally."
    },
    "eventTemplateId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Event Template Id",
      "examples": [
        "template_marketing_001",
        "event_type_abc"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the event template. Provided in the URL path.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Event Template ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the event template you want to update by adding this token. This tells us exactly which template to modify."
    },
    "objectPropertyName": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Property Name",
      "examples": [
        "last_feedback_score",
        "recent_order_link",
        "contact_lead_source"
      ],
      "description": "The name of an existing CRM object property (e.g., 'dealstage', 'lifecyclestage'). If provided, this token will populate the specified CRM object property associated with the event. This allows for building or updating CRM objects through the Timeline API.",
      "human_parameter_description": "If you want this token to update an existing CRM property, enter that property's name here (for example, 'dealstage'). Leave blank if not needed."
    }
  },
  "description": "Defines the data required to add a new token to an existing event template."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json

  "$defs": {
```

## HUBSPOT_ARCHIVE_BATCH_OF_FEEDBACK_SUBMISSIONS
Asynchronously archives a batch of HubSpot feedback submissions using their unique IDs, which must correspond to valid and existing submissions; the operation is queued, and submissions are moved from active views without being deleted.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ArchiveBatchOfFeedbackSubmissionsRequest",
  "required": [
    "inputs"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "inputs": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "InputsRequest",
        "required": [
          "id"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Id",
            "examples": [
              "123456789",
              "987654321"
            ],
            "description": "The unique identifier of the feedback submission to be archived.",
            "human_parameter_name": "Feedback ID",
            "human_parameter_description": "Enter the unique ID of the feedback submission you want to archive. You can copy this from a previous search or list of submissions, or from the submission's URL."
          }
        },
        "description": "Request schema for `Inputs`"
      },
      "title": "Inputs",
      "description": "A list of objects, where each object contains the 'id' of a feedback submission to be archived.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Feedback Inputs",
      "human_parameter_description": "Provide a list of feedback items to archive. For each item, include the 'id' of the submission so multiple submissions can be archived at once."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `ArchiveBatchOfFeedbackSubmissions`"
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "ArchiveBatchOfFeedbackSubmissionsResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "ArchiveBatchOfFeedbackSubmissionsResponse",
      "properties": {},
      "description": "Response schema for `ArchiveBatchOfFeedbackSubmissions`\n\nNote: This endpoint returns HTTP 204 with an empty response body upon successful execution.\nThe Feedback Submissions API is read-only and archive operations were removed in SDK v12.0.0-beta.1.\nThis action may not function as the endpoint is no longer available in the current HubSpot API."
    }
  },
  "title": "ArchiveBatchOfFeedbackSubmissionsResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "properties": {},
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## HUBSPOT_ARCHIVE_BATCH_OF_LINE_ITEMS
Archives a batch of existing line items by their unique IDs in HubSpot CRM; this operation is irreversible via the API.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ArchiveBatchOfLineItemsRequest",
  "required": [
    "inputs"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "inputs": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "InputsRequest",
        "required": [
          "id"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Id",
            "examples": [
              "1012345",
              "2034567"
            ],
            "description": "The unique identifier of the line item to be archived.",
            "human_parameter_name": "Line Item ID",
            "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the line item you want to archive. Paste the exact ID from HubSpot or from a previous list/search of line items."
          }
        },
        "description": "Request schema for individual line item archival input."
      },
      "title": "Inputs",
      "description": "A list of objects, where each object contains the 'id' of a line item to be archived.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Line Item Inputs",
      "human_parameter_description": "Add the line items you want to archive, each including its ID. Use this to archive several items in one request."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for batch archiving line items by their IDs."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_ARCHIVE_BATCH_OF_PROPERTIES
Archives a batch of properties by their internal names for a specified HubSpot CRM object type; this operation is idempotent and safe to retry.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ArchiveBatchOfPropertiesRequest",
  "required": [
    "objectType",
    "inputs"
  ],
  "properties": {

          "name"

            "type": "string",
            "title": "Name",
            "description": "The internal name of the property to be archived.",

    },
    "objectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "contacts",
        "companies",

      "human_parameter_name": "Object Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose the type of record whose properties you want to archive (e.g., contacts, companies, deals, tickets). This tells us where the properties currently live."

}
```

## HUBSPOT_AUDIT_PIPELINE_CHANGES
Retrieves a reverse chronological audit log of all changes for a specific, existing HubSpot CRM pipeline, which is identified by its `pipelineId` and a valid `objectType` that supports pipelines (e.g., 'deals', 'tickets').

**Input schema:**

```json
{

    "objectType",
    "pipelineId"

    "objectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "deals",
        "tickets",
        "contacts",
        "companies"
      ],
      "description": "The HubSpot CRM object type that has pipelines (e.g., 'deals', 'tickets'); determines the pipeline's context. Must be a valid, case-sensitive object type.",

      "human_parameter_description": "Choose the type of HubSpot record the pipeline belongs to (for example, 'deals' or 'tickets'). This tells us where to look for the pipeline's change history."
    },
    "pipelineId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pipeline Id",
      "examples": [
        "default_pipeline_123",
        "support_line_alpha"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of an existing pipeline within the specified `objectType` for which to retrieve the audit history.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Pipeline ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter the ID of the specific pipeline you want to review. You can copy this from your HubSpot pipeline settings or from a previous list of pipelines."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `AuditPipelineChanges`"
}
```

## HUBSPOT_BATCH_READ_COMPANIES_BY_PROPERTIES
Batch-retrieves up to 100 HubSpot company records by their IDs in a single request. Supports custom ID properties (e.g., domain), selective property retrieval, and historical property values.

**Input schema:**

## HUBSPOT_BATCH_UPDATE_QUOTES
Updates multiple existing HubSpot quotes in a batch; each quote is identified by its object ID or a custom unique property (via `idProperty`), and only writable properties are modified.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "BatchUpdateQuotesRequest",
  "required": [
    "inputs"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "inputs": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "InputsRequest",
        "required": [
          "id",
          "properties"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Id",
            "examples": [
              "123456789",
              "QUOTE-ABC-123"
            ],
            "description": "The quote's HubSpot object ID or the value of the unique property specified by `idProperty`.",
            "human_parameter_name": "Quote ID",
            "human_parameter_description": "Provide the quote's ID or the value of the unique identifier you named in 'Unique Property'. This is how we find the exact quote you want to update."
          },
          "idProperty": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Id Property",
            "examples": [
              "custom_unique_id_property"
            ],
            "description": "Name of the unique property used for quote identification if `id` is not the HubSpot object ID. If omitted, `id` is assumed to be the object ID.",
            "human_parameter_name": "Unique Property",
            "human_parameter_description": "If you're not using the standard HubSpot quote ID, enter the name of the unique field you use to identify quotes. This tells us how to interpret the value you provide in 'Quote ID'."
          },
          "properties": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Properties",
            "examples": [
              "{\"hs_title\": \"Updated Q3 Proposal\", \"hs_expiration_date\": \"2024-09-30\"}",
              "{\"hs_status\": \"APPROVED\", \"hs_comments\": \"Customer approved the new terms.\"}"
            ],
            "description": "Dictionary of writable properties to update (e.g., `hs_title`, `hs_status`). Keys are internal property names; values are the new property values.",
            "additionalProperties": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "human_parameter_name": "Properties",
            "human_parameter_description": "Add the quote fields to update (for example, title, status, or expiration date) and their new values. Include only the fields you want changed."
          }
        },
        "description": "Defines a single quote update, specifying its identifier and the properties to change."
      },
      "title": "Inputs",
      "description": "List of `InputsRequest` objects, each specifying a quote to update and its new property values.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Quote Updates",
      "human_parameter_description": "Add one or more quote updates, each with the quote identifier and the fields you want to change. Use this to update many quotes in a single request."
    }
  },
  "description": "Container for a list of quote update operations to be performed in batch."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_CANCEL_IMPORT
Cancels an active HubSpot data import job using its `importId`; this action is irreversible, and any data already processed will remain.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CancelImportRequest",
  "required": [
    "importId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "importId": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Import Id",
      "examples": [
        12345,
        67890
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier for the active HubSpot import job to be cancelled; must correspond to an import job currently in progress.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Import ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the active HubSpot import you want to cancel. You can copy it from your running imports list or from the response when you started the import."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for cancelling an active HubSpot import job."
}
```

**Output schema:**

## HUBSPOT_CLONE_MARKETING_EMAIL
Duplicates an existing HubSpot marketing email, identified by its `id`, into a new draft; an optional `cloneName` can be assigned to this new email copy.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CloneMarketingEmailRequest",
  "required": [
    "id"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id",
      "examples": [
        "1234567890",
        "9876543210"
      ],
      "description": "The unique identifier of the existing marketing email to be cloned.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Email ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the marketing email you want to copy. You can find this in your HubSpot email list or from a previous search/list step."
    },
    "cloneName": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Clone Name",
      "examples": [
        "New Q4 Promotional Email",
        "Follow-up Email (Version C)"
      ],
      "description": "The name for the newly cloned marketing email. If not provided, HubSpot may assign a default name (e.g., 'Copy of [Original Email Name]').",
      "human_parameter_name": "Clone Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "What you want to name the copied email. Choose a clear name to identify this version, or leave it blank to let HubSpot name it for you."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for cloning a HubSpot marketing email."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_CONFIGURE_CALLING_EXTENSION_SETTINGS
Configures or updates settings for a HubSpot app's calling extension, including its name, UI URL, iframe dimensions, `isReady` status, and `supportsCustomObjects` flag, for the specified `appId`.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ConfigureCallingExtensionSettingsRequest",
  "required": [
    "appId",
    "name",
    "width",
    "url",
    "height"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Url",
      "examples": [
        "https://mycallingservice.com/ui",
        "https://anothercaller.com/app"
      ],
      "description": "Publicly accessible HTTPS URL for the phone/calling UI, which should be built using the HubSpot Calling SDK.",
      "human_parameter_name": "UI URL",
      "human_parameter_description": "The public HTTPS link to your calling UI that HubSpot will open in an embedded window. Provide the page users should see when they start a call."
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "My Awesome Caller",
        "Sales Dialer Pro"
      ],
      "description": "Display name for the calling service in the HubSpot interface.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Service Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "The label users will see for this calling service in HubSpot. Choose a clear name your team will recognize."
    },
    "appId": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "App Id",
      "examples": [
        "123456",
        "789012"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier for the target HubSpot app whose calling extension settings are being configured.",
      "human_parameter_name": "App ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the HubSpot app whose calling extension you want to configure. This tells HubSpot which app to update."
    },
    "width": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Width",
      "examples": [
```

## HUBSPOT_CREATE_AB_TEST_VARIATION
Creates a new A/B test variation for an existing HubSpot marketing email, using its `contentId`; the new variation is created as a draft that can be edited before publishing. This action only creates the variation—it does not start the A/B test or send emails. Note: If an active variation already exists for the email, a new one will not be created. Requires Marketing Hub Professional or Enterprise subscription.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateAbTestVariationRequest",
  "required": [
    "variationName",
    "contentId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "contentId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Content Id",
      "examples": [
        "1234567890",
        "9876543210"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the original email content to use as a template for the new variation.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Content ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose the original email you want to base this variation on by providing its content ID. You can copy this ID from the email\u2019s details or use one returned from a previous list or search."
    },
    "variationName": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Variation Name",
      "examples": [
        "Variation B - New Subject",
        "CTA Test Version 2"
      ],
      "description": "A unique name for the new A/B test variation.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Variation Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "Give this new email version a clear, unique name so you can recognize it later in your A/B test results. Use a name that hints at what you're changing, like the subject or call to action."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to create an A/B test variation of an email."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_CREATE_AND_RETURN_A_NEW_PROPERTY_GROUP
Creates a new, empty property group for a specified CRM object type in HubSpot, requiring a unique group name for that object type; properties must be added separately.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateAndReturnANewPropertyGroupRequest",
  "required": [
    "objectType",
    "name",
    "label"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "sales_info",
        "marketing_details"
      ],
      "description": "The unique internal programmatic name for the property group within the specified `objectType`, used for API referencing.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Group Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "A unique internal name for this group that you\u2019ll use when referencing it later. Keep it short and descriptive; it must be unique within the chosen object type."
    },
    "label": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Label",
      "examples": [
        "Sales Information",
        "Marketing Details"
      ],
      "description": "Human-readable label for the property group, displayed in the HubSpot UI.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Label",
      "human_parameter_description": "The friendly name users will see for this group in HubSpot. Make it clear and readable so teammates recognize the group."
    },
    "objectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "contacts",
        "companies",
        "deals",
        "tickets",
        "custom_object_type_id"
      ],
      "description": "The CRM object type for which the property group will be created.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Object Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "The type of CRM record (like contacts, companies, deals, or tickets) that this property group will belong to. Choose the one where you want the group to appear in HubSpot."
    },
    "displayOrder": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Display Order",
      "examples": [
        1,
        2,
        -1
      ],
      "description": "Order in which the group appears in the HubSpot UI. Positive values are sorted ascendingly; -1 places it after groups with positive `displayOrder`. If unspecified, the group is added at the end.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Display Order",
      "human_parameter_description": "Controls where this group appears in the HubSpot UI list. Use a small positive number to place it higher, or leave blank to add it to the end."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to create a new property group for a CRM object type in HubSpot."
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "CreateAndReturnANewPropertyGroupResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "CreateAndReturnANewPropertyGroupResponse",
      "required": [
        "archived",
        "displayOrder",
        "label",
        "name"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "description": "The unique internal name used for API references to this property group."
        },
        "label": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Label",
          "description": "The human-readable label displayed in the HubSpot UI for this property group."
        },
        "archived": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Archived",
          "description": "Indicates whether the property group is archived (always false for newly created groups)."
        },
        "displayOrder": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Display Order",
          "description": "The display order assigned to the property group. Positive integers are sorted ascending, with the API automatically assigning the next available position if -1 was specified."
        }
      },
      "description": "Contains the details of the newly created HubSpot property group."
    }
  },
  "title": "CreateAndReturnANewPropertyGroupResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "archived",
        "displayOrder",
        "label",
        "name"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "description": "The unique internal name used for API references to this property group."
        },
        "label": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Label",
          "description": "The human-readable label displayed in the HubSpot UI for this property group."
        },
        "archived": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Archived",
          "description": "Indicates whether the property group is archived (always false for newly created groups)."
        },
        "displayOrder": {
          "type": "integer",
          "title": "Display Order",
          "description": "The display order assigned to the property group. Positive integers are sorted ascending, with the API automatically assigning the next available position if -1 was specified."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## HUBSPOT_CREATE_A_NEW_MARKETING_EMAIL

## HUBSPOT_CREATE_ASSOCIATION
Creates a new custom association definition (schema) for a custom object in HubSpot, specifying how this object type can relate to another object type; this defines the association type itself, not actual record-to-record links. Note: This endpoint requires crm.schemas.custom.write scope and only works with custom objects (not standard HubSpot objects like contacts or companies).

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateAssociationRequest",
  "required": [
    "objectType",
    "fromObjectTypeId",
    "toObjectTypeId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "custom_contact_to_company_association",
        "primary_deal_contact",
        "project_lead_for_contact"
      ],
      "description": "Optional, user-defined unique name for the new association type (e.g., 'contact_to_company_custom'). If not supplied, HubSpot may generate a default.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Association Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "An optional, human-friendly unique name for this association type so you and your team can recognize it later. If you leave it blank, a default name will be used."
    },
    "objectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "2-123456",
        "2-789012",
        "my_custom_object"
      ],
      "description": "Fully qualified name or object type ID (e.g., '2-12345') of the CUSTOM object schema for which the new association type is being defined. Must be a custom object, not a standard HubSpot object.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Custom Object Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "The custom object type whose schema you want to add this association to. This must be a custom object (e.g., '2-123456' or 'my_custom_object'), not a standard HubSpot object like contacts or companies."
    },
    "toObjectTypeId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "To Object Type Id",
      "examples": [
        "companies",
        "0-2",
        "deals",
        "0-3",
        "2-456789"
      ],
      "description": "Object type ID or fully qualified name for the 'to' side of the association. For standard objects use names ('contacts', 'companies', 'deals', 'tickets') or IDs ('0-1', '0-2', '0-3', '0-5'). For custom objects use their objectTypeId (e.g., '2-12345').",
      "human_parameter_name": "To Object Type ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The object type on the 'to' side of the relationship. Use standard object names like 'companies' or '0-2', or custom object IDs like '2-12345'."
    },
    "fromObjectTypeId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "From Object Type Id",
      "examples": [
        "contacts",
        "0-1",
        "companies",
        "0-2",
        "2-123456"
      ],
      "description": "Object type ID or fully qualified name for the 'from' side of the association. For standard objects use names ('contacts', 'companies', 'deals', 'tickets') or IDs ('0-1', '0-2', '0-3', '0-5'). For custom objects use their objectTypeId (e.g., '2-12345').",
      "human_parameter_name": "From Object Type ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The object type on the 'from' side of the relationship. Use standard object names like 'contacts' or '0-1', or custom object IDs like '2-12345'."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `CreateAssociation`"
}
```

## HUBSPOT_CREATE_BATCH_OF_FEEDBACK_SUBMISSIONS
Creates a batch of feedback submissions in HubSpot, ideal for bulk imports; all property names, `associationTypeId`s, and association `to_id`s must reference existing entities in HubSpot.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateBatchOfFeedbackSubmissionsRequest",
  "required": [
    "inputs"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "inputs": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "InputsRequest",
        "required": [
          "associations",
          "properties"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "properties": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Properties",
            "examples": [
              {
                "hs_comments": "Loved the new feature!",
                "hs_csat_rating": "5",
                "hs_survey_name": "Product Feedback Q3"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Key-value pairs of properties for the feedback submission. Names are case-sensitive. Custom properties use their internal HubSpot name (e.g., `my_custom_property`).",
            "additionalProperties": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "human_parameter_name": "Submission Properties",
            "human_parameter_description": "The details you want to save for this feedback, like rating, comments, and survey name. Use the internal property names as keys and the values you want to set."
          },
          "associations": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "title": "AssociationsRequest",
              "required": [
                "types"
              ],
              "properties": {
                "types": {
                  "type": "array",
                  "items": {
                    "type": "object",
                    "title": "TypesRequest",
                    "required": [
                      "associationCategory",
                      "associationTypeId"
                    ],
                    "properties": {
                      "associationTypeId": {
                        "type": "integer",
                        "title": "Association Type Id",
                        "examples": [
                          280,
                          279
                        ],
                        "description": "ID for the association type, defining the relationship's nature (e.g., feedback submission to contact). Find in HubSpot settings or via associations API.",
                        "human_parameter_name": "Association Type ID",
                        "human_parameter_description": "The numeric ID of the association type to use for this relationship. Copy it from your HubSpot settings or a prior lookup so the correct records are linked."
                      },
                      "associationCategory": {
                        "enum": [
                          "HUBSPOT_DEFINED",
                          "USER_DEFINED",
                          "INTEGRATOR_DEFINED"
                        ],
                        "type": "string",
                        "title": "Association Category",
                        "examples": [
                          "HUBSPOT_DEFINED",
                          "USER_DEFINED"
                        ],
                        "description": "Category of the association: `HUBSPOT_DEFINED` (standard), `USER_DEFINED` (custom), or `INTEGRATOR_DEFINED` (integration-created). HubSpot-defined are generally recommended.",
                        "human_parameter_name": "Association Category",
                        "human_parameter_description": "Select where this relationship type comes from\u2014HubSpot\u2019s standard types, your own custom types, or one created by an integration. Most users should choose HUBSPOT_DEFINED unless you\u2019ve set up custom or integration types."
                      }
                    },
                    "description": "Request schema for defining association types."
                  },
                  "title": "Types",
                  "description": "A list of association types to be created between the feedback submission and other CRM objects.",
                  "human_parameter_description": "Specify the relationship(s) to create between this feedback submission and other CRM records. Provide one or more type entries to define how the records should be connected."
                },
                "to__id": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "To  Id",
                  "examples": [
                    "512345",
                    "company_109876"
                  ],
                  "description": "ID of the target CRM object (e.g., Contact, Company, Deal, Ticket) for association.",
                  "human_parameter_name": "Target CRM ID",
                  "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the record you want to link to (such as a contact, company, deal, or ticket). You can get this from the record\u2019s URL or a previous search or list."
                }
              },
              "description": "Request schema for defining associations between a feedback submission and other CRM objects."
            },
            "title": "Associations",
            "description": "A list of associations to be created for this feedback submission with other CRM objects.",
            "human_parameter_description": "Which CRM records this single feedback submission should be connected to. Add one or more associations to link it to contacts, companies, deals, or tickets."
          }
        },
        "description": "Request schema for a single feedback submission within a batch."
      },
      "title": "Inputs",
      "description": "A list of feedback submission objects to create. Each object defines the properties and associations for a new feedback submission.",
      "human_parameter_description": "All the feedback submissions you want to create in this batch. Add one item per submission with its properties and any associations to other records."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for creating a batch of feedback submissions."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_CREATE_BATCH_OF_OBJECTS
Creates multiple CRM objects of a specified `objectType` (e.g., contacts, companies, deals) in a single batch operation, where each object can have its own set of properties and associations.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateBatchOfObjectsRequest",
  "required": [
    "objectType",
    "inputs"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "inputs": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "InputsRequest",
        "required": [
          "properties"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "properties": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Properties",
            "examples": [
              "{\"email\": \"batch.contact@example.com\", \"firstname\": \"Batch\", \"lastname\": \"User\"}",
              "{\"dealname\": \"New Batch Deal\", \"amount\": \"75000\", \"dealstage\": \"presentationscheduled\"}"
            ],
            "description": "A dictionary of properties for the object; keys are internal property names, and values are their corresponding string values. Property names must be valid for the specified `objectType`.",
            "additionalProperties": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "human_parameter_name": "Properties",
            "human_parameter_description": "Provide the field values for the new record using internal property names and their values. Include all required fields for the chosen object type so creation succeeds."
          },
          "associations": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "title": "AssociationsRequest",
              "required": [
                "types",
                "to"
              ],
              "properties": {
                "to": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "title": "To",
                  "required": [
                    "id"
                  ],
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "title": "Id",
                      "description": "The unique identifier of the existing object to associate with the new object.",
                      "human_parameter_name": "ID",
                      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the existing record you want to link to this new object."
                    }
                  },
                  "description": "The target object for the association.",
                  "additionalProperties": false,
                  "human_parameter_name": "To",
                  "human_parameter_description": "The target object containing the ID of the record you want to link to this new object."
                },
                "types": {
                  "type": "array",
                  "items": {
                    "type": "object",
                    "title": "TypesRequest",
                    "required": [
                      "associationCategory",
                      "associationTypeId"
                    ],
                    "properties": {
                      "associationTypeId": {
                        "type": "integer",
                        "title": "Association Type Id",
                        "description": "The unique identifier for the type of association (e.g., contact to company, deal to contact).",
                        "human_parameter_name": "Association Type ID",
                        "human_parameter_description": "Enter the specific association type ID that represents how these two records relate (e.g., contact-to-company). Use the ID that matches the relationship you want to create."
                      },
                      "associationCategory": {
                        "enum": [
                          "HUBSPOT_DEFINED",
                          "USER_DEFINED",
                          "INTEGRATOR_DEFINED"
                        ],
                        "type": "string",
                        "title": "Association Category",
                        "examples": [
                          "HUBSPOT_DEFINED",
                          "USER_DEFINED",
                          "INTEGRATOR_DEFINED"
                        ],
                        "description": "The category of the association, indicating how it was defined.",
                        "human_parameter_name": "Association Category",
                        "human_parameter_description": "Choose how this relationship is defined (HubSpot default, your own custom type, or an integration). This helps clarify the kind of link you're creating."
                      }
                    },
                    "description": "Defines the type and category of an association."
                  },
                  "title": "Types",
                  "description": "A list defining the types of associations to create.",
                  "human_parameter_name": "Types",
                  "human_parameter_description": "Pick one or more association definitions to create between the new record and the existing one. Each item specifies the category and type ID of the relationship."
                }
              },
              "description": "Specifies an association to be created between the new object and an existing object."
            },
            "title": "Associations",
            "examples": [
              [],
              [
                {
                  "types": [
                    {
                      "associationTypeId": 1,
                      "associationCategory": "HUBSPOT_DEFINED"
                    }
                  ],
                  "to__id": "123456"
                }
              ]
            ],
            "description": "Optional. List of associations to create for this object. If you do not want to associate this object with any others, omit this field or provide an empty list. Example with associations: [{...}]. Example with none: [].",
            "human_parameter_name": "Associations",
            "human_parameter_description": "Add any relationships this new record should have with records that already exist. Leave empty if you don't need to link it to anything yet."
          }
        },
        "description": "Represents a single object to be created in the batch, including its properties and associations."
      },
      "title": "Inputs",
      "description": "A list of objects to be created in batch. Each item in the list defines the properties and associations for a new object.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Inputs",
      "human_parameter_description": "List the records you want to create in this batch. Each item includes the record's properties and any links to other records."
    },
    "objectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "contacts",
        "companies",
        "deals",
        "tickets",
        "products",
        "line_items",
        "YOUR_CUSTOM_OBJECT_TYPE_ID"
      ],
      "description": "The type of CRM object to create in batch (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies', 'deals', 'tickets', 'products', 'line_items', or a custom object ID). Must be a valid HubSpot CRM object type.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Object Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Select the kind of CRM record you want to create (for example, contacts, companies, deals, or a custom object). This tells the system which fields and rules to use."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for creating a batch of CRM objects."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_CREATE_BATCH_OF_PROPERTIES
Efficiently creates multiple CRM properties in a single batch for a specified HubSpot object type (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies', custom object ID), ideal for schema setup or updates.

## HUBSPOT_CREATE_BATCH_OF_QUOTES
Creates multiple HubSpot CRM quotes in a batch, ideal for bulk operations; provide meaningful quote details in `inputs` as property requirements can vary, and inspect response for individual quote statuses as partial success is possible.

## HUBSPOT_CREATE_CAMPAIGNS
Creates multiple HubSpot campaigns by calling the single campaign creation endpoint for each campaign. Note: HubSpot does not provide a native batch create endpoint for campaigns. This action creates multiple campaigns by making individual API calls for each campaign in the batch.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateABatchOfCampaignsRequest",
  "required": [
    "inputs"
  ],
  "properties": {

      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "InputsRequest",
        "required": [
          "name"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "name": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Name",
            "examples": [
              "Summer Sale 2024"
            ],
            "description": "Campaign name.",
            "human_parameter_name": "Campaign Name",
            "human_parameter_description": "The title of your campaign as it should appear to you and your team. Choose a clear name so you can easily find and report on this campaign later."
          },
          "type": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Type",
            "examples": [
              "EMAIL",
              "SOCIAL"
            ],
            "description": "Campaign type.",
            "human_parameter_name": "Campaign Type",
            "human_parameter_description": "Select the channel or format for this campaign, such as EMAIL or SOCIAL. This helps apply the right settings and organize your campaigns."
          }
        },
        "description": "Request schema for creating individual campaigns within a batch operation."
      },
      "title": "Inputs",
      "description": "List of campaign objects to create.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Campaign Inputs",
      "human_parameter_description": "Add the campaigns you want to create in this batch. Each item should include the campaign name and can optionally include the type."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for creating a batch of campaigns."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_CREATE_COMPANY
Creates a new HubSpot company.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateCompanyObjectRequest",
  "properties": {
    "zip": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Zip",
      "examples": [
        "94105"
      ],
      "description": "Company's postal code.",
      "is_property": true,
      "human_parameter_description": "The company\u2019s postal or ZIP code. Used for mailing and location-based workflows."
    },
    "city": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "City",
      "examples": [
        "San Francisco"
      ],
      "description": "City where the company is located.",
      "is_property": true,
      "human_parameter_description": "The city where the company is located. Useful for mailing and segmentation."
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "Acme Corporation"
      ],
      "description": "Company name.",
      "is_property": true,
      "human_parameter_description": "The company\u2019s name (legal or common). This is the primary name shown in HubSpot."
    },
    "type": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Type",
      "examples": [
        "PROSPECT",
        "CUSTOMER"
      ],
      "description": "Type of company.",
      "is_property": true,
      "human_parameter_description": "The company type or status (for example, prospect or customer). Use the term your team recognizes."
    },
    "phone": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Phone",
      "examples": [
        "+1-555-123-4567"
      ],
      "description": "Company's primary phone number.",
      "is_property": true,
      "human_parameter_description": "The company\u2019s main phone number. Include the country code if applicable."
    },
    "state": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "State",
      "examples": [
        "California"
      ],
      "description": "State or region where the company is located.",
      "is_property": true,
      "human_parameter_description": "The state, province, or region for the company\u2019s address. Useful for localization and routing."
    },
    "domain": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Domain",
      "examples": [
        "example.com"
      ],
      "description": "Company's primary domain name.",
      "is_property": true,
      "human_parameter_description": "The company\u2019s primary website domain (without https://). HubSpot can use this to help prevent duplicates."
    },
    "address": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Address",
      "examples": [
        "123 Business St"
```

## HUBSPOT_CREATE_CONTACT_FROM_NL
Creates a new contact in HubSpot from a natural language description. Fetches the contact property schema at runtime, uses an LLM to generate the correct property payload, and creates the contact.

**Input schema:**
```json

  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateContactFromNlRequest",
  "required": [
    "nl_query"
  ],
  "properties": {

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Nl Query",
      "description": "Natural language description of the contact to create. Example: 'Add Jane Smith, email jane@test.com, phone +1-555-0100, company Acme Corp'."
    },
    "associations": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": true
      },
      "title": "Associations",
      "description": "Optional associations to create between the new contact and other CRM objects (e.g., companies, deals). Pass-through field, not LLM-generated."
    }
  }
}
```

## HUBSPOT_CREATE_CRM_OBJECT_FROM_NL
Creates a new CRM object (contact, deal, company, ticket, or custom object) in HubSpot from a natural language description. Fetches the object's property schema at runtime, uses an LLM to generate the correct property payload, and creates the object.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateCrmObjectFromNlRequest",
  "required": [
    "objectType",
    "nl_query"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "nl_query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Nl Query",
      "description": "Natural language description of the record to create. Example: 'Create a contact named John Doe with email john@example.com and phone +1-555-0100'."
    },
    "objectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "contacts",
        "deals",
        "companies",
        "tickets"
      ],
      "description": "The type of CRM object to create. Standard types: 'contacts', 'deals', 'companies', 'tickets'. Can also be a custom object type ID."
    },
    "associations": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": true
      },
      "title": "Associations",
      "description": "Optional associations to create between the new object and other CRM objects. Pass-through field, not LLM-generated. Each association should include 'to' and 'types'."
    }
  }
}
```

## HUBSPOT_CREATE_CRM_OBJECT_WITH_PROPERTIES
Creates a new HubSpot CRM object (e.g., contact, company, custom object) with specified `properties` (using valid internal names) and `associations` (to existing objects via valid type IDs).

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateCrmObjectWithPropertiesRequest",
  "required": [
    "objectType",
    "associations",
    "properties"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "objectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "contacts",
        "companies",
        "deals",
        "tickets",
        "p_my_custom_object_id"
      ],
      "description": "Type of CRM object to create (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies', 'deals', or custom object schema ID like 'p12345678').",
      "human_parameter_name": "Object Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "The kind of CRM record you want to create, like contacts, companies, deals, tickets, or a custom object ID. This tells HubSpot where to create the new record."
    },
    "properties": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Properties",
      "examples": [
        "{\"email\": \"jane.doe@example.com\", \"firstname\": \"Jane\", \"lastname\": \"Doe\"}",
        "{\"name\": \"Acme Corp\", \"domain\": \"acme.com\", \"industry\": \"COMPUTER_SOFTWARE\", \"city\": \"San Francisco\"}",
        "{\"dealname\": \"New Q4 Deal\", \"amount\": \"50000\", \"dealstage\": \"appointmentscheduled\", \"closedate\": \"2023-12-31T23:59:59Z\"}"
      ],
      "description": "Key-value pairs for the object's properties. Keys must be internal HubSpot property names valid for the `objectType`. IMPORTANT: Some properties are enumeration types that only accept specific values. For CONTACTS: 'email' (string), 'firstname' (string), 'lastname' (string), 'phone' (string), 'lifecyclestage' (enum: subscriber, lead, marketingqualifiedlead, salesqualifiedlead, opportunity, customer, evangelist, other). For COMPANIES: 'name' (string, required), 'domain' (string), 'phone' (string), 'city' (string), 'state' (string), 'country' (string), 'industry' (enum - must use UPPERCASE values like: ACCOUNTING, AIRLINES_AVIATION, BANKING, BIOTECHNOLOGY, COMPUTER_SOFTWARE, CONSTRUCTION, CONSUMER_GOODS, EDUCATION_MANAGEMENT, ENTERTAINMENT, FINANCIAL_SERVICES, FOOD_BEVERAGES, GOVERNMENT_ADMINISTRATION, HEALTH_WELLNESS_AND_FITNESS, HOSPITAL_HEALTH_CARE, HOSPITALITY, INFORMATION_TECHNOLOGY_AND_SERVICES, INSURANCE, INTERNET, LEGAL_SERVICES, MANAGEMENT_CONSULTING, MANUFACTURING, MARKETING_AND_ADVERTISING, MEDIA_PRODUCTION, NON_PROFIT_ORGANIZATION_MANAGEMENT, OIL_ENERGY, PHARMACEUTICALS, REAL_ESTATE, RETAIL, TELECOMMUNICATIONS, TRANSPORTATION_TRUCKING_RAILROAD, VENTURE_CAPITAL_PRIVATE_EQUITY, WHOLESALE, and ~115 more). For DEALS: 'dealname' (string, required), 'amount' (string/number), 'dealstage' (enum: pipeline-specific stage IDs), 'closedate' (ISO 8601 date), 'pipeline' (pipeline ID). For TICKETS: 'subject' (string), 'content' (string), 'hs_pipeline' (pipeline ID), 'hs_pipeline_stage' (stage ID), 'hs_ticket_priority' (enum: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH). Use GET /crm/v3/properties/{objectType} to retrieve all valid properties and their enum options for any object type.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "human_parameter_name": "Properties",
      "human_parameter_description": "The field values to set on the new record. Use internal property names for the selected object type. CRITICAL: Enumeration properties (like 'industry' for companies, 'lifecyclestage' for contacts) require specific valid values - free-text values will be rejected. For 'industry', use UPPERCASE enum values like COMPUTER_SOFTWARE, BANKING, RETAIL, etc. Query GET /crm/v3/properties/{objectType}/{propertyName} to get the full list of valid enum options for any property."
    },
    "associations": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "AssociationsRequest",
        "required": [
          "types"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "to": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "type": "string"
              },
              {
                "type": "object",
                "additionalProperties": {
                  "type": "string"
                }
              }
            ],
            "title": "To",
            "examples": [
              "1234567890",
              "9876543210",
              {
                "id": "1234567890"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Unique ID of the existing CRM object to associate with the new object. Can be a string ID or dict with 'id' key.",
            "human_parameter_name": "Target Object ID",
            "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the existing CRM record you want to link to this new object. Use the record's HubSpot ID."
          },
          "types": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "title": "TypesRequest",
              "required": [
                "associationCategory",
                "associationTypeId"
              ],
              "properties": {
                "associationTypeId": {
                  "type": "integer",
                  "title": "Association Type Id",
                  "examples": [
                    3,
                    5,
                    280,
                    342
                  ],
                  "description": "Unique ID for the association type. CRITICAL: Must be valid for the SOURCE objectType being created. Association type IDs are DIRECTIONAL - when creating objectType='deals', use Deal-to-X type IDs. IDs BY SOURCE OBJECT TYPE: When creating 'contacts': Contact-to-Company=279 (or 1 for Primary), Contact-to-Deal=4, Contact-to-Ticket=15. When creating 'companies': Company-to-Contact=280 (or 2 for Primary), Company-to-Deal=342 (or 6 for Primary), Company-to-Ticket=340. When creating 'deals': Deal-to-Contact=3, Deal-to-Company=341 (or 5 for Primary), Deal-to-Ticket=27. When creating 'tickets': Ticket-to-Contact=16, Ticket-to-Company=339 (or 26 for Primary), Ticket-to-Deal=28. Use GET /crm/v4/associations/{fromObjectType}/{toObjectType}/labels to find all valid type IDs.",
                  "human_parameter_name": "Association Type ID",
                  "human_parameter_description": "The numeric ID of the specific association type. CRITICAL: Must match the objectType you are creating as the SOURCE. Examples: When creating a 'deals' object, use Deal-to-X IDs (e.g., Deal-to-Contact=3, Deal-to-Company=5). When creating a 'companies' object, use Company-to-X IDs (e.g., Company-to-Contact=280, Company-to-Deal=6). When creating a 'contacts' object, use Contact-to-X IDs (e.g., Contact-to-Company=1, Contact-to-Deal=4). Using an ID from the wrong direction (e.g., Deal-to-Contact=3 when creating a company) will cause an error."
                },
                "associationCategory": {
                  "enum": [
                    "HUBSPOT_DEFINED",
                    "USER_DEFINED",
                    "INTEGRATOR_DEFINED"
                  ],
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Association Category",
                  "examples": [
                    "HUBSPOT_DEFINED",
                    "USER_DEFINED",
                    "INTEGRATOR_DEFINED"
                  ],
                  "description": "Category of the association type (HubSpot-defined, user-defined, or integrator-defined).",
                  "human_parameter_name": "Association Category",
                  "human_parameter_description": "Pick whether this association type is HubSpot-defined, user-defined, or created by an integration. This helps ensure the correct relationship is applied when linking records."
                }
              },
              "description": "Defines the type of association, including its category and type ID."
            },
            "title": "Types",
            "description": "List defining association types, each specifying `associationCategory` and `associationTypeId`.",
            "human_parameter_name": "Association Types",
            "human_parameter_description": "One or more association type entries that describe how the records should be related. Include the category and type ID for each association you want to create."
          }
        },
        "description": "An association for the new CRM object, detailing the target object's ID and the type of association."
      },
      "title": "Associations",
      "description": "List of associations to create between the new object and existing CRM objects, using `to_id` and `types`.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Associations",
      "human_parameter_description": "Any relationships you want to create between this new record and existing records (for example, associate a contact with a company). Add one entry for each link you need."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request payload for creating a new CRM object, specifying its type, properties, and associations."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_CREATE_DEAL_FROM_NL
Creates a new deal in HubSpot from a natural language description. Fetches the deal property schema and pipeline stages at runtime, uses an LLM to generate the correct property payload, and creates the deal.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateDealFromNlRequest",
  "required": [
    "nl_query"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "nl_query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Nl Query",
      "description": "Natural language description of the deal to create. Example: 'New deal: Enterprise License for Acme Corp, amount $50,000, closing next month'."
    },
    "pipeline": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pipeline",
      "description": "Optional pipeline ID override. If not specified, the LLM will infer from the NL query or default to 'default'."
    },
    "associations": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": true
      },
      "title": "Associations",
      "description": "Optional associations to create between the new deal and other CRM objects (e.g., contacts, companies). Pass-through field, not LLM-generated."
    }
  }
}
```

## HUBSPOT_CREATE_DEALS
Creates multiple deals in HubSpot CRM; ensure any associated object IDs, deal stages, and pipeline IDs specified are valid and exist within the HubSpot account.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateBatchOfDealsRequest",
  "required": [
    "inputs"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "inputs": {

              "amount": {

                  "2500.50"
                ],

                "human_parameter_name": "Deal Amount",

              },

                "type": "string",
                "title": "Hs Acv",
                "description": "Annual Contract Value (ACV) of the deal.",
                "human_parameter_name": "Annual Contract Value",
                "human_parameter_description": "Enter the annual contract value for this deal to support revenue tracking."
              },
              "hs_arr": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Hs Arr",
                "description": "Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) of the deal.",
                "human_parameter_name": "Annual Recurring Revenue",
                "human_parameter_description": "Enter the annual recurring revenue for subscription deals to improve ARR reporting."
              },
              "hs_mrr": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Hs Mrr",
                "description": "Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) of the deal.",
                "human_parameter_name": "Monthly Recurring Revenue",
                "human_parameter_description": "Enter the monthly recurring revenue for subscription deals to support MRR reporting."
              },
              "hs_tcv": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Hs Tcv",
                "description": "Total Contract Value (TCV), including one-time and recurring charges.",
                "human_parameter_name": "Total Contract Value",
                "human_parameter_description": "Enter the total contract value, including one-time and recurring charges, for full revenue visibility."
              },
              "dealname": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Dealname",
                "examples": [
                  "New Website Project",
                  "Q4 Enterprise Sale"
                ],
                "description": "Name or title of the deal. Typically required for creating a new deal.",
                "human_parameter_name": "Deal Name",
                "human_parameter_description": "Give the deal a clear, descriptive name so it\u2019s easy to recognize in your pipeline."
              },
              "dealtype": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Dealtype",
                "examples": [

                  "existing_business"

                "description": "Type of deal (e.g., 'newbusiness', 'existingbusiness'), typically custom-defined.",
                "human_parameter_name": "Deal Type",
                "human_parameter_description": "Indicate whether this is new or existing business (or your custom type) for reporting."
              },
              "pipeline": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Pipeline",
                "examples": [
                  "default",
                  "sales_pipeline_2"
                ],
                "description": "ID or internal name of the sales pipeline this deal belongs to.",
                "human_parameter_name": "Sales Pipeline",
                "human_parameter_description": "Select the sales pipeline this deal belongs to so stages and reporting match your process."
              },
              "closedate": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Closedate",
                "examples": [
                  "2024-12-31",
                  "1704067200000"
                ],
                "description": "Expected or actual close date (e.g., YYYY-MM-DD or Unix timestamp in milliseconds).",
                "human_parameter_name": "Close Date",
                "human_parameter_description": "Set the expected or actual close date to keep timelines and reports accurate."
              },
              "dealstage": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Dealstage",
                "examples": [
                  "appointmentscheduled",
                  "qualifiedtobuy",
                  "presentationscheduled",
                  "decisionmakerboughtin",
                  "contractsent",
                  "closedwon",
                  "closedlost"
                ],
                "description": "ID or internal name of the current deal stage within a HubSpot pipeline.",
                "human_parameter_name": "Deal Stage",
                "human_parameter_description": "Select the current stage of this deal in its pipeline to show progress."
              },

                "type": "string",
                "title": "Createdate",
                "description": "Read-only: Date and time the deal was created.",
                "human_parameter_name": "Create Date",

              "description": {
                "type": "string",
                "title": "Description",
```

## HUBSPOT_CREATE_EMAIL
Creates a new HubSpot email engagement record. REQUIRED FIELDS in properties dict: - hs_email_subject: Subject line - hs_email_html: HTML content - hs_timestamp: Unix timestamp in milliseconds - hs_email_direction: One of 'EMAIL', 'INCOMING_EMAIL', 'FORWARDED_EMAIL', 'DRAFT_EMAIL' This creates an email engagement/activity record in HubSpot CRM, not a marketing email.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateRequest",
  "required": [
    "properties"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "properties": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Properties",
      "examples": [
        {
          "hs_timestamp": "1640000000000",
          "hs_email_html": "<p>Hello World</p>",
          "hs_email_subject": "Test Email",
          "hs_email_direction": "EMAIL"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Email properties to set. Keys are HubSpot internal property names. REQUIRED fields: 'hs_email_subject' (subject line), 'hs_email_html' (HTML content), 'hs_timestamp' (Unix timestamp in milliseconds), 'hs_email_direction' (one of: 'EMAIL', 'INCOMING_EMAIL', 'FORWARDED_EMAIL', 'DRAFT_EMAIL'). This creates an email engagement/activity record in HubSpot CRM.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "human_parameter_name": "Email Properties",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter the required email details: subject, HTML content, timestamp (Unix ms), and direction (EMAIL, INCOMING_EMAIL, FORWARDED_EMAIL, or DRAFT_EMAIL). This creates an email engagement record in HubSpot."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for creating an email."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_CREATE_EVENT_TEMPLATE_FOR_APP
Creates a new event template for a HubSpot app, defining structure, custom properties (tokens), and appearance (Markdown with Handlebars) of custom timeline events for CRM objects; this template must exist before logging corresponding events.

**Input schema:**

```json
      "human_parameter_description": "A short summary line that appears as the event's title in the timeline. You can use Markdown and tokens for dynamic values."

  "description": "Request schema to create a new event template for a HubSpot app."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_CREATE_FEEDBACK_SUBMISSION
Creates a new HubSpot feedback submission to record customer feedback (e.g., survey responses, support interactions), optionally associating it with CRM objects.

**Input schema:**
```json

      ],

      },

    },

      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "AssociationsRequest",

          "types"

                  "title": "Association Category",
                  "examples": [

                  "description": "Category of the association: 'HUBSPOT_DEFINED' (standard HubSpot), 'USER_DEFINED' (custom in account), or 'INTEGRATOR_DEFINED' (integration-created).",

            "title": "To  Id",

            "description": "ID of the target HubSpot CRM object for association (e.g., contact ID, ticket ID).",
            "human_parameter_name": "Target ID",
            "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the record you want to link this feedback submission to (for example, a contact or ticket). Paste the record\u2019s ID so HubSpot knows which item to associate."
          }
        },
        "description": "Request schema for `Associations`"
      },
      "title": "Associations",
      "description": "Associations between this feedback submission and other CRM objects, specifying target object ID and association types.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Feedback Associations",

    }

  "description": "Request schema for `CreateFeedbackSubmission`"
}
```

```json
              "type": "string"
            },
```

## HUBSPOT_CREATE_NOTE
Creates a new HubSpot CRM note. Use when you need to add a timestamped note with optional attachments and associations to contacts, companies, deals, or tickets.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateNoteRequest",
  "required": [
    "hs_timestamp"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "associations": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {},
      "title": "Associations",
      "description": "List of associations to link with the note (e.g., contacts, deals, companies)."
    },
    "hs_note_body": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Hs Note Body",
      "examples": [
        "Discussed contract details and next steps."
      ],
      "description": "Text content of the note (up to 65,536 characters)."
    },
    "hs_timestamp": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "integer"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Hs Timestamp",
      "examples": [
        "2021-11-12T15:48:22Z",
        1636730902000
      ],
      "description": "Creation time of the note. Either an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (e.g., '2021-11-12T15:48:22Z') or Unix milliseconds since epoch."
    },
    "hubspot_owner_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Hubspot Owner Id",
      "examples": [
        "14240720"
      ],
      "description": "HubSpot user ID to assign as the creator/owner of this note."
    },
    "custom_properties": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Custom Properties",
      "description": "A dictionary of custom properties. Boolean-type fields accept 'Yes'/'No', 'true'/'false', '1'/'0', 'on'/'off', 'y'/'n' and Python booleans, which are auto-converted to string values ('true'/'false') for HubSpot API compatibility.",
      "additionalProperties": true
    },
    "hs_attachment_ids": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Hs Attachment Ids",
      "examples": [
        "24332474034;24332474044"
      ],
      "description": "Semicolon-separated list of file attachment IDs."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for creating a HubSpot note with optional associations."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_CREATE_OBJECT_ASSOCIATION
Tool to create or label an association between two CRM records using HubSpot Associations v4 API. Use when you need to link records (e.g., contact to company, deal to contact) with explicit association labels.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "CreateObjectAssociationRequest",
  "required": [
    "objectType",
    "objectId",
    "toObjectType",
    "toObjectId",
    "labels"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "labels": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "AssociationLabel",
        "required": [
          "associationCategory",
          "associationTypeId"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "associationTypeId": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Association Type Id",
            "examples": [
              1,
              2,
              3,
              5,
              280
            ],
            "description": "The numeric type ID for this association label. Standard type IDs include: 1 (contact to company), 2 (company to contact primary), 3 (deal to contact), 5 (deal to company), etc. Custom associations use IDs >= 100000."
          },
          "associationCategory": {
            "enum": [
              "HUBSPOT_DEFINED",
              "USER_DEFINED",
              "INTEGRATOR_DEFINED"
            ],
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Association Category",
            "examples": [
              "HUBSPOT_DEFINED",
              "USER_DEFINED"
            ],
            "description": "Category of the association: HUBSPOT_DEFINED for standard associations, USER_DEFINED for custom user-created associations, or INTEGRATOR_DEFINED for integration-specific associations."
          }
        },
        "description": "Association label descriptor with category and type ID."
      },
      "title": "Labels",
      "minItems": 1,
      "description": "Array of association label descriptors defining the type(s) of relationship between the two records. Each label includes an associationCategory and associationTypeId."
    },
    "objectId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Id",
      "examples": [
        "12345",
        "67890"
      ],
      "description": "The unique ID of the source CRM record."
    },
    "objectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "contacts",
        "companies",
        "deals",
        "tickets"
      ],
      "description": "The type of the source object (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies', 'deals', 'tickets', or a custom object type)."
    },
    "toObjectId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "To Object Id",
      "examples": [
        "54321",
        "98765"
      ],
      "description": "The unique ID of the target CRM record to associate with."
    },
    "toObjectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "To Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "companies",
        "contacts",
        "deals",
        "tickets"
      ],
      "description": "The type of the target object to associate with (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies', 'deals', 'tickets', or a custom object type)."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for creating/labeling an association between two CRM records."
}
```
