## HUBSPOT_LIST_ASSOCIATION_TYPES
Lists all valid association types between two specified HubSpot CRM object types.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListAssociationTypesRequest",
  "required": [
    "fromObjectType",
    "toObjectType"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "toObjectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "To Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "contacts",
        "companies",
        "deals",
        "tickets"
      ],
      "description": "The type of the second object in the association (e.g., contact, company, deal).",
      "human_parameter_name": "To Object Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose the type of the second CRM record you want to see associations to (for example, contacts, companies, deals, or tickets). This is the destination object type you are checking relationships for."
    },
    "fromObjectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "From Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "contacts",
        "companies",
        "deals",
        "tickets"
      ],
      "description": "The type of the first object in the association (e.g., contact, company, deal).",
      "human_parameter_name": "From Object Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose the type of the first CRM record you are starting from (for example, contacts, companies, deals, or tickets). This is the object whose possible associations to another type you want to list."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `ListAssociationTypes`"
}
```

## HUBSPOT_LIST_CONTACT_PROPERTIES
Lists all contact properties in your HubSpot account, including custom properties you've created. Use this action to discover: - Available property names for updating contacts - Custom properties specific to your HubSpot account - Property types and valid options for enumeration fields - Which properties are read-only vs writable

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListContactPropertiesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "archived": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Archived",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Whether to include archived properties. Set to true to see archived properties, false for active only.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Include Archived",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set to true to include archived/deleted properties in the results."
    },
    "custom_only": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Custom Only",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Filter to only return custom properties (excludes HubSpot default properties). Custom properties are ones you created in your HubSpot account.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Custom Properties Only",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set to true to only see custom properties you created, excluding HubSpot's built-in default properties."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for listing HubSpot contact properties."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_LIST_CONTACTS
Retrieves a paginated list of HubSpot contacts.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListContactsPageRequest",
  "properties": {
    "after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "After",
      "examples": [
        "1234567890",
        "CMTYzNjQzNTM1Mg%3D%3D"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination token from `paging.next.after` of a previous response, used to fetch the subsequent page. Omit for the first page. Empty strings will be treated as None.",
      "human_parameter_name": "After",
      "human_parameter_description": "The value from the previous page to continue where you left off. Leave blank to start from the first page."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "default": 5,
      "maximum": 100,
      "examples": [
        "5",
        "10",
        "100"
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of contacts to return per page, controlling pagination size (default: 5).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Limit",
```

## HUBSPOT_LIST_DEALS
Retrieves a paginated list of HubSpot deals.

**Input schema:**
```json

    "archived": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Archived",

      "examples": [
        "false",

      "items": {

        ]
      ],
      "description": "List of object types for which to retrieve associated IDs.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Associations",

  "description": "Request schema for retrieving a paginated list of deals."
```

## HUBSPOT_LIST_EMAILS
Retrieves a paginated list of HubSpot emails, allowing selection of specific properties (with or without history), associated object IDs, and filtering by archive status.

**Input schema:**
```json
{

      "human_parameter_name": "Archived",

    "properties": {

        "type": "string"

      ],

    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for retrieving a paginated list of emails, allowing customization of returned properties and associations."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_LIST_FEEDBACK_SUBMISSIONS
Retrieves a paginated list of feedback submissions from HubSpot, allowing specification of properties (including history), associated object IDs, and filtering by archive status.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListFeedbackSubmissionsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "After",
      "examples": [
        "12345",
        "opaque_string_cursor_value"
      ],
      "description": "The pagination token to retrieve the next page of results. This value is obtained from the `paging.next.after` field of a previous response. If omitted, the first page is returned. Use with `limit` for iterating through large sets of feedback submissions.",
      "human_parameter_name": "After",
      "human_parameter_description": "If you\u2019re continuing from a previous page, paste the 'after' token from that response to get the next set of results. Leave blank to start from the first page."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "default": 10,
      "maximum": 100,
      "examples": [
        "10",
        "50",
        "100"
      ],
      "description": "The maximum number of feedback submissions to return per page. Using smaller values can lead to quicker responses, while larger values reduce the total number of API calls for large datasets.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Limit",
      "human_parameter_description": "How many feedback submissions to return on this page. Choose a smaller number for quicker responses; larger numbers reduce how many times you'll need to page through results."
    },
    "archived": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Archived",
      "default": false,
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Specifies whether to include archived feedback submissions. Set to `True` to retrieve only archived submissions. `False` (default) retrieves only active (non-archived) submissions. Useful for accessing historical or managing archived feedback.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Archived",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose whether to get archived submissions instead of active ones. Turn this on to view only archived feedback."
    },
    "properties": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Properties",
      "examples": [
        [
          "hs_sentiment",
          "hs_survey_name"
        ],
        [
          "hs_content",
          "hs_createdate"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "List of HubSpot internal property names to include for each feedback submission in the response (e.g., `hs_sentiment`, `hs_survey_name`, `hs_content`). If specified, only these properties are returned. If a property doesn't exist for a submission, it's ignored. If omitted, a default set of properties is returned.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Properties",
      "human_parameter_description": "Pick which fields you want returned for each submission. Only the properties you list will be included, keeping the results focused on what you need."
    },
    "associations": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Associations",
      "examples": [
        [
          "contact"
        ],
        [
          "survey",
          "ticket"
        ],
        [
          "company"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "List of object types (e.g., `contact`, `survey`, `ticket`) for which to retrieve associated IDs. This allows fetching IDs of related objects. If an association doesn't exist for a submission, it's ignored.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Associations",
      "human_parameter_description": "Select related object types (like contact, survey, or ticket) whose IDs you want included with each submission. This helps you link feedback to the records it\u2019s connected to."
    },
    "propertiesWithHistory": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Properties With History",
      "examples": [
        [
          "hs_status"
        ],
        [
          "hs_deal_stage",
          "hs_lead_status"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "List of HubSpot internal property names for which to include historical values. The response includes both current and past values for these properties. Requesting history may affect the number of submissions returned per page due to increased response size.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Properties With History",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose properties for which you also want past values, not just the current one. This is helpful when you need to see how a property changed over time."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `ListFeedbackSubmissions`"
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
```

## HUBSPOT_LIST_GRANTED_SCOPES
Tool to introspect the current OAuth access token and return its granted scopes and metadata. Use when you need to check which permissions are available before calling an endpoint (e.g., workflows, automation) to proactively detect missing scopes and provide clear remediation guidance.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListGrantedScopesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "include_token": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Include Token",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Whether to include the full access token in the response. Default is false to avoid exposing sensitive token values in logs."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request for introspecting OAuth token scopes."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_LIST_QUOTES
Retrieves a paginated list of quotes, allowing selection of specific properties, property history, associated object IDs, and filtering by archived status.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ListQuotesRequest",
  "properties": {
    "after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "After",
      "description": "Pagination token from a previous response's `paging.next.after` property to fetch the subsequent page. Use the exact token provided by the API; do not modify it.",
      "human_parameter_name": "After Token",
      "human_parameter_description": "The paging token from a previous response that tells us where to continue. Use the exact token you got from the last page to fetch the next set of quotes."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "default": 10,
      "maximum": 100,
      "examples": [
        "10",
        "25",
        "50"
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of quotes to return per page.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Limit",
      "human_parameter_description": "How many quotes to return on this page. Pick a number up to 100\u2014higher values show more results per request."
    },
    "archived": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Archived",
      "default": false,
      "examples": [
        "true",
        "false"
      ],
      "description": "If true, returns only archived quotes. If false, returns only active (non-archived) quotes.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Archived",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose whether to return archived quotes instead of active ones. Turn this on to see quotes that have been archived."
    },
    "properties": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Properties",
      "examples": [
        "hs_title",
        "hs_createdate",
        "hs_quote_amount",
        "hs_expiration_date"
      ],
      "description": "A list of quote property names to include in the response for each quote (e.g., `hs_title`, `hs_quote_amount`). Non-existent properties for a quote are ignored. If omitted, a default set of properties is returned.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Properties",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose which fields you want returned for each quote. Add only the properties you care about to keep the response focused and easier to work with."
    },
    "associations": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Associations",
      "examples": [
        "contacts",
        "companies",
        "deals",
        "line_items"
      ],
      "description": "A list of object types (e.g., `contacts`, `companies`, `deals`) for which to retrieve IDs of associated records. Non-existent association types or associations for a specific quote are ignored.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Associations",
      "human_parameter_description": "Which related record types you want IDs for (like contacts or deals). Include these to link each quote to its associated CRM records."
    },
    "propertiesWithHistory": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Properties With History",
      "examples": [
        "hs_status",
        "hs_quote_amount",
        "hs_lastmodifieddate"
      ],
      "description": "A list of quote property names for which historical values should be included (e.g., `hs_quote_amount`, `hs_expiration_date`). Using this may reduce the maximum number of quotes returnable per request due to increased data volume.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Properties With History",
      "human_parameter_description": "Which properties you'd like to see historical values for. Use this when you need the change history or an audit trail for those fields."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `ListQuotes` to fetch a paginated list of quotes."
}
```

Retrieves a paginated list of HubSpot tickets.

**Input schema:**
```json

      "title": "Archived",
      "default": false,

        "true"
```

## HUBSPOT_MERGE_LINE_ITEMS
Merges two line items, `objectIdToMerge` into `primaryObjectId`, which must be of the same type; `objectIdToMerge` is absorbed and the operation is irreversible.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "MergeLineItemsRequest",
  "required": [
    "objectIdToMerge",
    "primaryObjectId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "objectIdToMerge": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Id To Merge",
      "examples": [
        "1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the line item that will be merged into the primary line item. This line item will be absorbed and will no longer exist as a separate entity after the merge.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Line Item to Merge",
      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the line item you want to merge into the primary one. Pick the item that should be absorbed and no longer appear on its own after the merge."
    },
    "primaryObjectId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Primary Object Id",
      "examples": [
        "0987654321"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the primary line item that will remain after the merge. Its record will be updated with data from the line item specified by `objectIdToMerge`.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Primary Line Item",
      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the line item you want to keep as the main record. The other item\u2019s details will be combined into this one."
```

## HUBSPOT_MERGE_OBJECTS
Merges two distinct HubSpot CRM objects of the same `objectType`, consolidating data into `primaryObjectId` (which is preserved) and deleting `objectIdToMerge`; this operation is permanent and irreversible.

**Input schema:**
```json

  "type": "object",
  "title": "MergeObjectsRequest",
  "required": [
    "objectType",
    "objectIdToMerge",
    "primaryObjectId"

    "objectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "contacts",
        "companies",
        "deals",
        "tickets",
        "products"
      ],
      "description": "The CRM object type (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies') of the two records to merge. Must be a valid object type in your HubSpot account.",

      "human_parameter_description": "The type of CRM record you\u2019re working with, like contacts, companies, deals, or tickets. Choose the type that matches the two records you want to merge."
    },
    "objectIdToMerge": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Id To Merge",
      "description": "ID of the object to be merged into the primary object and subsequently deleted.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Object ID to Merge",
      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the record you want to merge into the primary record. Its data will be combined into the primary and then this record will be deleted."

      "title": "Primary Object Id",
      "description": "ID of the object that will remain after the merge, into which data from `objectIdToMerge` is consolidated.",

      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the record you want to keep after the merge. All data from the other record will be added to this one."

  },
  "description": "Request schema for `MergeObjects`"
}
```

## HUBSPOT_READ_ALL_PROPERTIES_FOR_OBJECT_TYPE
Retrieves definitions and metadata (not actual values) for properties of a specified HubSpot CRM object type (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies', 'deals', or custom objects).

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ReadAllPropertiesForObjectTypeRequest",
  "required": [
    "objectType"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "archived": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Archived",
      "default": false,
      "examples": [
        "true",
        "false"
      ],
      "description": "Filter properties by their archived status: `true` for archived, `false` for active (non-archived).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Archived Status",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose whether to include archived properties. Set to true to include archived ones, or leave as false to see only active properties."
    },
    "objectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "contacts",
        "companies",
        "deals",
        "tickets",
        "custom_object_type_id"
      ],
      "description": "Identifier for the CRM object type (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies'). Must be a valid, case-sensitive object type name existing in HubSpot.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Object Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "The HubSpot object type you want to look up (like contacts, companies, deals, or a custom type). This tells us which set of property definitions to retrieve."
    },
    "properties": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Properties",
      "examples": [
        "firstname,lastname,email",
        "hs_object_id,name,createdate"
      ],
      "description": "DEPRECATED/NON-FUNCTIONAL: This parameter appears in the API but does not work as expected. When provided, the API returns empty property objects instead of filtered results. Leave this parameter unset (None) to retrieve all properties.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Property Names (Non-functional)",
      "human_parameter_description": "WARNING: This parameter does not work correctly. The API returns empty objects when this is provided. Leave blank to get all properties."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `ReadAllPropertiesForObjectType`"
}
```

## HUBSPOT_READ_APAGE_OF_OBJECTS_BY_TYPE
Retrieves a paginated list of objects for a specified and valid HubSpot CRM object type (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies', 'deals', or custom ID).

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ReadApageOfObjectsByTypeRequest",
  "required": [
    "objectType"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "After",
      "examples": [
        "1234567890",
        "opaque_paging_token"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination token from a previous response's `paging.next.after` property, used to fetch the next page of results.",
      "human_parameter_name": "After",
      "human_parameter_description": "If you\u2019re continuing from a previous page, paste the 'after' token from that response to get the next set of results."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "default": 10,
      "examples": [
        "10",
        "50",
        "100"
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of results to return per page (must be an integer between 1 and 100).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Limit",
      "human_parameter_description": "How many items to return per page. Increase to see more results at once, or lower it for smaller pages."
    },
    "archived": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Archived",
      "default": false,
      "examples": [
        "true",
        "false"
      ],
      "description": "Set to true to retrieve only archived objects. If false or omitted (default), non-archived objects are returned.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Archived",
      "human_parameter_description": "Turn this on to return only archived items. Leave it off to get active (non-archived) items."
    },
    "objectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "contacts",
        "companies",
        "deals",
        "tickets",
        "marketing_events",
```

## HUBSPOT_READ_ASSOCIATIONS_BATCH
Tool to batch-read CRM associations (e.g., deals→contacts, deals→companies) for up to 1,000 source record IDs in one request. Use when you need to retrieve associated target IDs and association type metadata for multiple records efficiently, avoiding rate-limit issues from per-record GET calls.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ReadAssociationsBatchRequest",
  "required": [
    "fromObjectType",
    "toObjectType",
    "inputs"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "inputs": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "AssociationInputRequest",
        "required": [
          "id"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Id",
            "examples": [
              "12345",
              "67890"
            ],
            "description": "Source record ID to retrieve associations for."
          },
          "after": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "After",
            "examples": [
              "MTA"
            ],
            "description": "Per-source pagination cursor for retrieving next page of associations when a source has more than the page limit. Returned from previous response for this source record."
          }
        },
        "description": "Individual source record for batch association read."
      },
      "title": "Inputs",
      "examples": [
        [
          {
            "id": "12345"
          },
          {
            "id": "67890",
            "after": "MTA"
          }
        ]
      ],
      "description": "List of source record IDs to retrieve associations for (max 1,000 per request). Each input can include an optional 'after' cursor for per-source pagination."
    },
    "toObjectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "To Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "contacts",
        "companies",
        "deals",
        "0-1"
      ],
      "description": "Target object type for associations. Use standard names (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies', 'deals') or object type IDs (e.g., '0-1' for contacts). For custom objects, use their objectTypeId."
    },
    "fromObjectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "From Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "deals",
        "contacts",
        "companies",
        "0-3"
      ],
      "description": "Source object type for associations. Use standard names (e.g., 'deals', 'contacts', 'companies', 'tickets') or object type IDs (e.g., '0-3' for deals). For custom objects, use their objectTypeId (e.g., '2-12345')."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for batch reading CRM associations."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_READ_BATCH_CRM_OBJECT_PROPERTIES
Retrieves property definitions (metadata) for a batch of CRM object properties for a specified object type. Returns detailed information about property structure, data types, options, and configuration—not the actual property values of CRM records.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ReadBatchCrmObjectPropertiesRequest",
  "required": [
    "objectType",
    "archived",
    "inputs"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "inputs": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "InputsRequest",
        "required": [
          "name"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "name": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Name",
            "examples": [
              "firstname",
              "lastname",
              "email",
              "hs_object_id"
            ],
            "description": "The programmatic name of the CRM object property whose definition is to be retrieved.",
            "human_parameter_description": "The exact property name you want details for, like firstname or email. This tells us which property's definition to retrieve."
          }
        },
        "description": "Specifies an individual property for a batch read operation."
      },
      "title": "Inputs",
      "description": "A list of property identifiers, each specifying the 'name' of a property whose definition should be retrieved for the given `objectType`.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Inputs",
      "human_parameter_description": "List the property names you want details for. Add each property you need so their definitions are returned together."
    },
    "archived": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Archived",
      "examples": [
        "true",
        "false"
      ],
      "description": "If true, retrieves only archived property definitions; otherwise, retrieves non-archived definitions.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Archived",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose whether to return only archived properties (yes) or active ones (no). Use this to narrow results to the status you need."
    },
    "objectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "contacts",
        "companies",
        "deals",
        "tickets",
        "products",
        "p123_mycustomobject"
      ],
      "description": "The case-sensitive CRM object type (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies') for which properties are being read, matching the type in your HubSpot account.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Object Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Select the type of record these properties belong to, such as contacts, companies, or deals. This guides where we look up the property definitions."
    },
    "dataSensitivity": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Data Sensitivity",
      "examples": [
        "non_sensitive",
        "sensitive",
        "highly_sensitive"
      ],
      "description": "Optional filter to retrieve only properties with a specific data sensitivity level. Valid values: 'highly_sensitive', 'sensitive', 'non_sensitive'.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Data Sensitivity",
      "human_parameter_description": "Filter properties by their sensitivity classification (optional). Choose highly_sensitive, sensitive, or non_sensitive to narrow results."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to read a batch of CRM object property definitions."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_READ_BATCH_FEEDBACK_SUBMISSIONS_BY_ID_OR_PROPERTY
Retrieves up to 100 feedback submissions in a batch using their IDs or a specified unique `idProperty`, optionally including specified properties and their history.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ReadBatchFeedbackSubmissionsByIdOrPropertyRequest",
  "required": [
    "inputs"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "inputs": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "InputsRequest",
        "required": [
          "id"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Id",
            "description": "The unique identifier of the feedback submission.",
            "human_parameter_description": "Enter the identifier for this feedback submission. Use the standard submission ID or the value of the idProperty if you specified one."
          }
        },
        "description": "Identifies an individual feedback submission in a batch operation."
      },
      "title": "Inputs",
      "description": "Identifiers for feedback submissions to retrieve, using primary 'id' or `idProperty`.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Inputs",
      "human_parameter_description": "Add the submissions you want to retrieve. Each item should include the ID or the value of your chosen idProperty for one feedback submission."
    },
    "archived": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Archived",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Set to `true` to retrieve only archived submissions; `false` (default) for active submissions.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Archived",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose whether to return archived feedback only. Turn this on to fetch archived submissions; leave it off for active ones."
    },
    "idProperty": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id Property",
      "description": "Unique identifier property name to use instead of 'id'; `inputs` should contain values for this property if provided.",
      "human_parameter_name": "ID Property",
      "human_parameter_description": "If you use a custom field to identify submissions (for example, an external ID), enter that property's name here. Then provide matching values for it in the inputs list."
    },
    "properties": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Properties",
      "examples": [
        [
          "hs_survey_name",
          "hs_feedback_rating",
          "hs_feedback_comment"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Property names to return for each feedback submission; defaults if not specified.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Properties",
      "human_parameter_description": "List the properties (fields) you want returned for each submission. Include only what you need to keep the response concise. Leave empty to get default properties."
    },
    "propertiesWithHistory": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Properties With History",
      "examples": [
        [
          "hs_content",
          "hs_rating"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Property names for which to retrieve historical values; past values are included if updated.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Properties With History",
      "human_parameter_description": "List the property names you want to include with their full change history. Use this when you need to see how those values have changed over time. Leave empty if you don't need historical data."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for batch reading feedback submissions by ID or a specified property."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_READ_BATCH_OF_CRM_OBJECTS_BY_ID_OR_PROPERTY_VALUES
Reads a batch of CRM objects of a specified `objectType` using their HubSpot IDs or unique property values from the `inputs` list, allowing retrieval of specific `properties`, their historical values (`propertiesWithHistory`), and filtering by `archived` status.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ReadBatchOfCrmObjectsByIdOrPropertyValuesRequest",
  "required": [
    "objectType",
    "propertiesWithHistory",
    "inputs",
    "properties"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "inputs": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "InputsRequest",
        "required": [
          "id"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Id",
            "description": "Unique identifier of the CRM object, corresponding to `idProperty` if set, or the default object ID.",
            "human_parameter_description": "The unique value that identifies the CRM record you want to retrieve. Use the HubSpot object ID or the value of the property you set in 'ID Property' (for example, an email)."
          }
        },
        "description": "Identifies an individual CRM object to be read in a batch."
      },
      "title": "Inputs",
      "description": "List of objects, each with an 'id' identifying a CRM object to retrieve, using the HubSpot object ID or the value of `idProperty`.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Inputs",
      "human_parameter_description": "Provide the list of records to fetch. Each item should include an id that matches either the HubSpot object ID or the value of your chosen ID Property."
    },
    "archived": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Archived",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, retrieves only archived CRM objects; if false (default), retrieves non-archived objects.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Archived",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose whether to return archived records only. Turn this on to get only archived items; leave it off to get active (non-archived) records."
    },
    "idProperty": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id Property",
      "examples": [
        "email",
        "domain"
      ],
      "description": "Alternate unique identifier property name (e.g., 'email' for contacts) to use instead of the default object ID.",
      "human_parameter_name": "ID Property",
      "human_parameter_description": "If you're identifying records by a property instead of the default ID, enter that property's name (for example, email or domain). We'll match your inputs using this unique field."
    },
    "objectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "contacts",
        "companies",
        "deals",
        "tickets",
        "products"
      ],
      "description": "Type of CRM object to read (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies'). Determines which object collection to query.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Object Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Tell us which kind of CRM records you want to read, such as contacts, companies, deals, or tickets. This ensures we look in the right place."
    },
    "properties": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Properties",
      "examples": [
        [
          "firstname",
          "lastname",
          "email"
        ],
        [
          "name",
          "industry"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "List of property names to return for each CRM object. If omitted, default properties are returned.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Properties",
      "human_parameter_description": "List the specific fields you want returned for each record (e.g., firstname, lastname, email). Include only what you need."
    },
    "propertiesWithHistory": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Properties With History",
      "examples": [
        [
          "email",
          "lifecyclestage"
        ],
        [
          "hs_pipeline"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "List of property names for which to retrieve historical values.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Properties History",
      "human_parameter_description": "List the properties you want to see with their past values. Add the field names (like email or lifecyclestage) whose history you care about."
    }
  },
  "description": "Batch reads CRM objects by ID or specified property values."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_READ_BATCH_OF_LINE_ITEMS_BY_ID_OR_PROPERTY_VALUES
Retrieves a batch of HubSpot CRM line items by their IDs, or optionally by values of a custom unique property defined in `idProperty`.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ReadBatchOfLineItemsByIdOrPropertyValuesRequest",
  "required": [
    "propertiesWithHistory",
    "inputs",
    "properties"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "inputs": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "InputsRequest",
        "required": [
          "id"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Id",
            "examples": [
              "12345",
              "SKU-ABC"
            ],
            "description": "Identifier for the line item to retrieve. This can be the line item's unique ID or a value of the property specified in `idProperty`.",
            "human_parameter_description": "The unique ID or a unique property value of the line item you want to retrieve. This tells us exactly which line item to fetch."
          }
        },
        "description": "Request schema for `Inputs`"
      },
      "title": "Inputs",
      "description": "A list of objects, where each object contains the 'id' of a line item to retrieve. The 'id' can be the line item's unique ID or the value of the property specified in `idProperty`.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Inputs",
      "human_parameter_description": "Provide the list of line items to fetch, each with an id that matches either the standard ID or your chosen idProperty."
    },
    "archived": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Archived",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Whether to return only archived line items. If true, returns only archived line items; if false (default), returns only non-archived line items.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Archived",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set to true to return only archived line items, or false (default) to return only non-archived line items."
    },
    "idProperty": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id Property",
      "examples": [
        "SKU"
      ],
      "description": "The name of a property whose values are unique for that object type. Use this if you want to identify line items by a custom unique property instead of the default 'id'.",
      "human_parameter_name": "ID Property",
      "human_parameter_description": "If you identify line items by a custom unique field (like SKU), enter that property's name so we can look them up using that value instead of the default ID."
    },
    "properties": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Properties",
      "examples": [
        [
          "name",
          "price",
          "quantity"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "A list of property names to be returned in the response. If not specified, all readable properties will be returned.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Properties",
      "human_parameter_description": "List the fields you want returned for each line item (for example: name, price, quantity)."
    },
    "propertiesWithHistory": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Properties With History",
      "examples": [
        [
          "price",
          "quantity"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "A list of property names for which to return historical values; if a property has been updated, the response includes its previous values.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Properties With History",
      "human_parameter_description": "List the property names you want history for so you can see past values and how they changed over time."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `ReadBatchOfLineItemsByIdOrPropertyValues`"
}
```

## HUBSPOT_READ_BATCH_OF_QUOTES_BY_PROPERTY_VALUES
Efficiently retrieves a batch of HubSpot CRM quotes by their IDs (or a specified unique property), optionally including archived quotes, specific properties, and property history.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ReadBatchOfQuotesByPropertyValuesRequest",
  "required": [
    "propertiesWithHistory",
    "inputs",
    "properties"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "inputs": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "InputsRequest",
        "required": [
          "id"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Id",
            "description": "The unique identifier of the quote to retrieve. This ID corresponds to the value of the property specified in `idProperty` in the main request, or the quote's primary object ID if `idProperty` is not specified.",
            "human_parameter_description": "The value that identifies this specific quote. Use the field you chose in 'ID Property' (or the default quote ID if you left that blank)."
          }
        },
        "description": "Request schema for identifying individual quotes in a batch operation."
      },
      "title": "Inputs",
      "description": "A list of objects, each specifying a quote to retrieve. Each object must contain an `id` field that holds the identifier of the quote, corresponding to `idProperty` or the primary object ID.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Quote Inputs",
      "human_parameter_description": "The list of quotes you want to fetch. Each item should include the identifier value that matches your chosen 'ID Property' (or the default Quote ID)."
    },
    "archived": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Archived",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Specifies whether to include archived quotes in the results. If `true`, only archived quotes are returned. If `false` (default) or omitted, only active (non-archived) quotes are returned.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Include Archived",
      "human_parameter_description": "Select this to return only archived quotes. Leave it off to return only active (current) quotes."
    },
    "idProperty": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id Property",
      "examples": [
        "my_custom_unique_id_property"
      ],
      "description": "The name of the property to use as the unique identifier for the quotes specified in the `inputs` list. If omitted, the quote's primary object ID (e.g., `hs_object_id`) is used. This property must be a unique identifier for quotes.",
      "human_parameter_name": "ID Property",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose the quote field that uniquely identifies each quote in your inputs. If unsure, leave it blank to use the default Quote ID."
    },
    "properties": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Properties",
      "examples": [
        [
          "hs_title",
          "hs_createdate",
          "hs_quote_amount"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "A list of internal names of quote properties to be included in the response for each quote. If omitted, a default set of properties is returned by HubSpot. Refer to HubSpot documentation for default properties.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Response Properties",
      "human_parameter_description": "Pick the quote fields you want returned in the results. Provide their internal names to get only what you need."
    },
    "propertiesWithHistory": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Properties With History",
      "examples": [
        [
          "hs_quote_amount",
          "hs_deal_stage"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "A list of internal names of quote properties for which historical values should be retrieved. The response will include the history of changes for these properties.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Properties With History",
      "human_parameter_description": "Which quote fields you want a change history for. Add the internal names of properties where you need past values included."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for retrieving a batch of quotes by their property values."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_READ_CONTACT

```json

    },

        "12345",
        "56789"
      ],

    },

      "items": {

      "human_parameter_name": "Properties",
      "human_parameter_description": "Pick the specific contact fields you want returned (like email or phone). Leave this empty to include all available fields."

    "associations": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {

      "title": "Associations",

      },
      "title": "Properties With History",

      "human_parameter_name": "Properties with History",
      "human_parameter_description": "Fields for which you also want the change history. Choose this when you need to see past values and when they changed."
    }
  },

}
```

## HUBSPOT_READ_CONTACTS
Batch read multiple HubSpot contacts by their IDs or custom identifier property. This action retrieves up to 100 contacts per request using the HubSpot CRM batch read API. You can specify which contact properties to return and optionally include historical values for properties.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ReadBatchOfContactsByIdOrPropertiesRequest",
  "required": [
    "inputs"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "inputs": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "InputsRequest",
        "required": [
          "id"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Id",
            "examples": [
              "12345",
              "contact_abc"
            ],
            "description": "The unique identifier of the contact to retrieve.",
            "human_parameter_description": "The unique ID of the contact you want to fetch. You can copy this from a previous contact list or search so we pull the exact contact you mean."
          }
        },
        "description": "Request schema for `Inputs`"
      },
      "title": "Inputs",
      "description": "A list of contact identifiers to retrieve. Each object in the list should contain an `id` (or the `idProperty` if specified) of a contact.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Input Contacts",
      "human_parameter_description": "Provide the contacts to retrieve as a list of IDs (or your custom ID if you set idProperty). This tells us exactly which contacts to return."
    },
    "archived": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Archived",
      "default": false,
      "description": "Specifies if only archived contacts should be returned (`true`), or only non-archived contacts (`false`).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Archived",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose whether to return only archived contacts. Turn this on to see archived contacts; leave it off to get current, active contacts."
    },
    "idProperty": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id Property",
      "examples": [
        "my_custom_id_field"
      ],
      "description": "The name of an alternate unique identifier property to use for retrieving contacts. If specified, the `inputs` objects should provide values for this property instead of the default `id`.",
      "human_parameter_name": "ID Property",
      "human_parameter_description": "If you use a custom unique field instead of the standard ID (for example, 'external_id'), enter its name here so we can look up contacts using that field."
    },
    "properties": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Properties",
      "examples": [
        [
          "firstname",
          "lastname",
          "email"
        ],
        [
          "phone",
          "company"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Contact property names to include in the response. Optional - a default set is returned if unspecified.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Properties",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose which fields to return for each contact (e.g., firstname, lastname, email). Leave empty to get the default set of properties."
    },
    "propertiesWithHistory": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Properties With History",
      "examples": [
        [
          "email",
          "last_contacted"
        ],
        [
          "lead_status"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Contact property names for which to retrieve historical values. Optional - omit if history is not needed.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Properties With History",
      "human_parameter_description": "List the contact fields you want history for (e.g., email, last_contacted). We'll include how those values have changed over time. Leave empty if you don't need historical data."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `ReadBatchOfContactsByIdOrProperties`"
}
```

## HUBSPOT_READ_CRM_OBJECT_BY_ID
Retrieves a specific CRM object (e.g., contact, company, deal, ticket) by its ID or a unique property, optionally including specific properties, history, and associations.

**Input schema:**

Call this to retrieve an existing HubSpot email by its `emailId` or an alternative unique `idProperty`.

**Input schema:**

## HUBSPOT_READ_FEEDBACK_SUBMISSION_BY_ID
Reads a HubSpot feedback submission by its ID, optionally using a custom unique 'idProperty', and allows specifying properties to return including history and associations.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ReadFeedbackSubmissionByIdRequest",
  "required": [
    "feedbackSubmissionId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "archived": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Archived",
      "default": false,
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "Set to true to retrieve only archived submissions; false (default) retrieves active ones.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Archived",
      "human_parameter_description": "Select this if you want to fetch archived submissions instead of active ones. Turn it on only when you\u2019re specifically looking for an archived record."
    },
    "idProperty": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id Property",
      "examples": [
        "survey_response_id",
        "custom_external_identifier"
      ],
      "description": "Name of a unique property (e.g., 'survey_response_id') to use as the identifier instead of the internal object ID. Its values must be unique.",
      "human_parameter_name": "ID Property",
      "human_parameter_description": "If you identify submissions by a custom unique field, enter that field\u2019s name here (e.g., survey_response_id). Then provide its value in the Feedback Submission ID field."
    },
    "properties": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Properties",
      "examples": [
        [
          "hs_sentiment",
          "hs_feedback_comments",
          "hs_createdate"
        ],
        [
          "hs_object_id"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Specific feedback submission property names to include in the response; HubSpot ignores non-existent ones.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Properties",
      "human_parameter_description": "Which fields of the feedback submission you want returned. Add property names like hs_sentiment or hs_feedback_comments, or leave blank to use the defaults."
    },
    "associations": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Associations",
      "examples": [
        [
          "CONTACT",
          "DEAL"
        ],
        [
          "COMPANY"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Object types (e.g., 'CONTACT') for which to retrieve associated IDs; HubSpot ignores non-existent associations.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Associations",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose which related records to include (for example, CONTACT, DEAL, or COMPANY). This lets you see the IDs of records linked to the submission."
    },
    "feedbackSubmissionId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Feedback Submission Id",
      "examples": [
        "123456789",
        "my_unique_feedback_key_001"
      ],
      "description": "Identifier of the feedback submission to retrieve; use a custom property value if 'idProperty' is set. Must be an existing submission.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Feedback Submission ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique ID of the feedback submission you want to look up. If you use a custom ID property, enter that value here instead of the internal ID."
    },
    "propertiesWithHistory": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Properties With History",
      "examples": [
        [
          "hs_sentiment",
          "hs_lastmodifieddate"
        ],
        [
          "hs_feedback_rating_num"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Feedback submission property names for which to include a history of values; HubSpot ignores non-existent ones.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Properties With History",
      "human_parameter_description": "List any properties for which you also want to see past values and changes. Use this when you need to track how a field has changed over time."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to retrieve a specific HubSpot feedback submission."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_READ_PROPERTY_GROUP
Retrieves metadata for a specific property group of a given CRM object type, detailing its structure and attributes, but not the actual property values of CRM objects.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ReadPropertyGroupRequest",
  "required": [
    "objectType",
    "groupName"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "groupName": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Group Name",
      "examples": [
        "contact_information",
        "deal_details",
        "company_information"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier (name) of the property group to retrieve. These names are case-sensitive and often use lowercase letters and underscores.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Group Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "Type the exact name of the property group you want to view (for example, contact_information). This helps us retrieve that group's fields and details."
    },
    "objectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "contacts",
        "companies",
        "deals",
        "tickets",
        "products",
        "line_items"
      ],
      "description": "The type of CRM object for which to retrieve the property group.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Object Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Select the type of CRM record you want to work with (e.g., contacts, companies, deals). This tells the system where to look for the property group."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `ReadPropertyGroup`"
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json

  "$defs": {

        "displayOrder"

      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "description": "The internal property group name, which must be used when referencing the property group via the API. Must be unique."

        "label": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Label",
          "description": "A human-readable label that will be shown in HubSpot UI."

        "archived": {
```

## HUBSPOT_READ_PROPERTY_GROUPS_FOR_OBJECT_TYPE
Retrieves all property groups in a single call for a specified HubSpot CRM object type (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies'), returning only the groups themselves, not the individual properties within them.

```json
    "objectType"

  "properties": {
    "objectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "contacts",
        "companies",
        "deals",
        "tickets"
      ],
      "description": "Specifies the HubSpot CRM object type for which property groups will be retrieved.",

}
```

## HUBSPOT_REPLACE_ALL_PROPERTIES_OF_PIPELINE
Overwrites an entire CRM pipeline (specified by `objectType` and `pipelineId`) and all its stages with a new definition, returning the updated pipeline.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ReplaceAllPropertiesOfPipelineRequest",
  "required": [
    "objectType",
    "pipelineId",
    "displayOrder",
    "stages",
    "label"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "label": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Label",
      "description": "Unique label for this pipeline, for UI organization.",

      "type": "array",

        "type": "object",
        "title": "StagesRequest",

          "metadata",
          "displayOrder",
          "label"

        "properties": {
          "label": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Label",
            "description": "Unique label for this stage within the pipeline, for UI organization.",
            "human_parameter_description": "The name you want to show for this stage in the pipeline. Make it unique and easy to recognize."
          },
          "metadata": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Metadata",
            "description": "Stage-specific metadata, varying by pipeline type. For 'deals' pipelines, include 'probability' (e.g., `{'probability': 0.5}` for likelihood a deal will close, 0.0-1.0 in 0.1 increments). For 'tickets' pipelines, 'ticketState' (e.g., `{'ticketState': 'OPEN'}`) is optional, indicating if the ticket is 'OPEN' or 'CLOSED'.",
            "additionalProperties": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "human_parameter_description": "Provide any extra details this stage needs. For deals, set a probability between 0.0 and 1.0; for tickets, optionally include whether the ticket is OPEN or CLOSED."
          },
          "displayOrder": {
            "type": "integer",
            "title": "Display Order",
            "description": "Display order for this stage; stages with the same order are sorted alphabetically by `label`.",
            "human_parameter_description": "The position of this stage within the pipeline. Lower numbers appear first; stages with the same number are sorted by their label."
          }
        },
        "description": "Defines an individual stage within a pipeline."
      },
      "title": "Stages",
      "description": "A list of stage definitions that will completely replace all existing stages in the pipeline.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Stages",
      "human_parameter_description": "Provide the full list of stages exactly as you want them after the update. This will replace every existing stage, so include all stages in the correct order."
    },
    "objectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "deals",
        "tickets",
        "contacts"
      ],
      "description": "Identifies the CRM object type (e.g., 'deals', 'tickets') for the pipeline being updated.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Object Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "The kind of CRM record whose pipeline you want to update, like deals or tickets. Choose the object that this pipeline belongs to."
    },
    "pipelineId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pipeline Id",
      "description": "Unique ID of the pipeline to update, specific to its `objectType`.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Pipeline ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The specific pipeline you want to replace. You can copy this ID from your CRM or a previous list/get pipelines step."
    },
    "displayOrder": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Display Order",
      "description": "Display order for this pipeline; those with the same order are sorted alphabetically by `label`.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Display Order",
      "human_parameter_description": "Where this pipeline should appear in lists relative to other pipelines. Lower numbers show up first; ties are ordered by the label."
    },
    "validateReferencesBeforeDelete": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Validate References Before Delete",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If true, validates existing references to the pipeline before updating to prevent issues from modifying referenced stages.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Validate References",
      "human_parameter_description": "Turn this on to check for existing links to stages before replacing the pipeline. It helps prevent breaking dashboards, automations, or reports that depend on those stages."
    },
    "validateDealStageUsagesBeforeDelete": {
      "type": "boolean",

      "human_parameter_name": "Validate Deal Usages",
      "human_parameter_description": "For deal pipelines, turn this on to check where stages are in use before you replace them. It helps avoid disrupting active deals or workflows."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to replace all properties and stages of a pipeline."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_REPLACE_PIPELINE_STAGE_PROPERTIES
Replaces all properties of a specified pipeline stage; the new `label` must be unique within the pipeline, and if `objectType` is 'deals', the `metadata` must include a 'probability' key.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "ReplacePipelineStagePropertiesRequest",
  "required": [
    "objectType",
    "pipelineId",
    "stageId",
    "metadata",
    "displayOrder",
    "label"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "label": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Label",
      "examples": [
        "Appointment Scheduled",
        "Contract Sent",
        "Closed Won (Deal)"
      ],
      "description": "A new label for the pipeline stage.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Label",
      "human_parameter_description": "The name you want people to see for this stage. Pick something clear and unique within the pipeline."
    },
    "stageId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Stage Id",
      "examples": [
        "stage_abc_789"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the specific pipeline stage to be updated, assigned by HubSpot and unique to the stage within its pipeline.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Stage ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The exact stage within the pipeline you want to change. Find this from the pipeline\u2019s stage list or a prior stage lookup."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        "{\"probability\": \"0.7\"}",
        "{\"ticketState\": \"CLOSED\"}",
        "{\"probability\": \"0.3\", \"custom_field_key\": \"custom_value\"}"
      ],
      "description": "Key-value pairs for custom stage properties; all values must be strings. For 'deals' `objectType`, 'probability' (string: number from 0.0-1.0 in 0.1 increments, e.g., '0.5') is required. For 'tickets' `objectType`, 'ticketState' (string: 'OPEN' or 'CLOSED') is optional.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "human_parameter_name": "Metadata",
      "human_parameter_description": "Additional settings for the stage, like probability for deal stages or ticket state for ticket pipelines. Provide simple key\u2013value pairs to define how this stage behaves."
    },
    "objectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "deals",
        "tickets",
        "contacts",
        "companies"
      ],
      "description": "The CRM object type associated with the pipeline (e.g., 'deals' for sales pipelines, 'tickets' for support pipelines).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Object Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose the kind of pipeline you're updating, like deals for sales or tickets for support. This ensures we update the right pipeline type in your CRM."
    },
    "pipelineId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pipeline Id",
      "examples": [
        "sales_pipeline_123"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the pipeline, assigned by HubSpot when the pipeline is created.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Pipeline ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The specific pipeline you want to edit. You can copy this from your CRM\u2019s pipeline settings or from a previous list of pipelines."
    },
    "displayOrder": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Display Order",
      "examples": [
        "0",
        "1",
        "10",
        "-1"
      ],
      "description": "The display order for this pipeline stage. Stages with the same `displayOrder` value are sorted alphabetically by their label. Use -1 to place the stage at the end.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Display Order",
      "human_parameter_description": "Where this stage should appear in the pipeline. Use -1 to move it to the end, or a number to set its position."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `ReplacePipelineStageProperties`"
}
```

## HUBSPOT_RESET_DRAFT
Resets a marketing email's draft to its currently published (live) version, discarding all unpublished changes; the email must have a live version to revert to.

**Input schema:**

```json
  "title": "ResetDraftRequest",
  "required": [
    "emailId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "emailId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Email Id",
      "examples": [
        "1234567890"
      ],
      "description": "Identifier of the marketing email whose draft will be reset to its currently published (live) version.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Email ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique identifier of the marketing email you want to reset. This helps us find the exact email so its draft can be reverted to the live version."
```

```json
  "title": "ResetDraftResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",

      "properties": {},
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Error",
      "description": "Error if any occurred during the execution of the action"
    },
    "successful": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Successful",
      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## HUBSPOT_RETRIEVE_ALL_PIPELINES_FOR_SPECIFIED_OBJECT_TYPE
Retrieves all pipelines in HubSpot for a specified CRM object type, such as deals or tickets.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "RetrieveAllPipelinesForSpecifiedObjectTypeRequest",
  "required": [
    "objectType"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "objectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "deals",
        "tickets"
      ],
      "description": "The case-sensitive CRM object type (e.g., 'deals', 'tickets') for which to retrieve pipelines; must support pipelines.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Object Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose the kind of CRM object you want pipelines for, like 'deals' or 'tickets'. This tells us which set of pipelines to fetch from your HubSpot account."
```

## HUBSPOT_RETRIEVE_LINE_ITEM_BY_ID

**Input schema:**
```json

  "type": "object",
```

```json
    "LineItemProperties": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "LineItemProperties",
      "properties": {

          "type": "string",
          "title": "Tax",
          "description": "The tax amount applied to the line item."
        },

          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "description": "The item designation or product name."
        },
        "price": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Price",
          "description": "The unit price of the line item for the buyer."
        },
        "amount": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Amount",
          "description": "The net price or total cost (quantity \u00d7 unit price) of the line item."
        },
        "hs_acv": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Acv",
          "description": "The annual contract value for the line item."
        },
        "hs_arr": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Arr",
          "description": "The annual recurring revenue for the line item."
        },
        "hs_mrr": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Mrr",
          "description": "The monthly recurring revenue for the line item."
        },
        "hs_sku": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Sku",
          "description": "The unique product identifier (SKU)."
        },
        "hs_tcv": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Tcv",
          "description": "The total contract value for the line item."
        },
        "hs_url": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Url",
          "description": "The product listing website link or URL."
        },
        "quantity": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Quantity",
          "description": "The number of units of a product in the line item."
        },
        "hs_images": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Images",
          "description": "The uploaded line item image location or URL."
        },
        "hs_margin": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Margin",
          "description": "The product margin value."
        },
        "createdate": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Createdate",
          "description": "The timestamp when the line item was created."
        },
        "description": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Description",
          "description": "Full product details or description."
        },
        "hs_discount": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Discount",
          "description": "The discount amount per unit."
        },
        "hs_object_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Object Id",
          "description": "The unique record ID of the line item (auto-generated)."
        },
        "hs_createdate": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Createdate",
          "description": "The timestamp when the line item was created (ISO-8601 format)."
        },
        "hs_product_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Product Id",
          "description": "The ID of the associated product from the product library."
        },
        "hs_tax_amount": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Tax Amount",
          "description": "The tax amount calculated based on the tax rate."
        },
        "hs_variant_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Variant Id",
          "description": "The Shopify product variant ID."
        },
        "hs_product_type": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Product Type",
          "description": "The product type categorized as Inventory, Non-Inventory, or Service."
        },
        "price_after_tax": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Price After Tax",
          "description": "The net price after tax has been applied."
        },
        "hs_all_owner_ids": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs All Owner Ids",
          "description": "The main team of the record owner."
        },
        "hs_billing_terms": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Billing Terms",
          "description": "The billing terms, either fixed payments or automatic renewal until cancellation."
        },
        "hs_object_source": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Object Source",
          "description": "How the record was created (record source)."
        },
        "hs_pricing_model": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Pricing Model",
          "description": "The pricing model, either 'flat' or 'tiered'."
        },
        "hubspot_owner_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hubspot Owner Id",
          "description": "The ID of the line item owner."
        },
        "hs_term_in_months": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Term In Months",
          "description": "The duration of the billing term in months."
        },
        "hs_lastmodifieddate": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Lastmodifieddate",
          "description": "The timestamp when the line item was last modified (ISO-8601 format)."
        },
        "hs_object_source_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Object Source Id",
          "description": "The record source details 1."

        "hs_merged_object_ids": {

        },
        "hs_cost_of_goods_sold": {

          "title": "Hs Cost Of Goods Sold",
          "description": "The internal unit cost of the product."
        },
        "hs_created_by_user_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Created By User Id",
          "description": "The user ID who created the line item (automatically set by HubSpot)."
        },
        "hs_number_of_payments": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Number Of Payments",
          "description": "The number of payments for the specified billing period."
        },
        "hs_updated_by_user_id": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Updated By User Id",
          "description": "The user ID who last updated the line item (automatically set by HubSpot)."
        },
        "hs_discount_percentage": {
          "type": "string",

        "hs_object_source_label": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Object Source Label",
          "description": "The record source details 2."
        },
        "hs_pre_discount_amount": {
          "type": "string",

          "description": "The line item amount before any discounts are applied."
        },
        "hs_effective_unit_price": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Effective Unit Price",
          "description": "The price that gets applied with tiered pricing."

        "hs_object_source_detail_1": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Object Source Detail 1",

        "hs_object_source_detail_2": {

        "hs_object_source_detail_3": {

        "recurringbillingfrequency": {

        "hs_line_item_currency_code": {

          "title": "Hs Line Item Currency Code",

        },
        "hubspot_owner_assigneddate": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hubspot Owner Assigneddate",
          "description": "The timestamp of the most recent owner assignment."

        "hs_billing_start_delay_days": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Billing Start Delay Days",
          "description": "The number of days billing should be delayed by."

        "hs_billing_start_delay_type": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Billing Start Delay Type",
          "description": "The type of billing start delay."
        },
        "hs_recurring_billing_period": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Recurring Billing Period",
          "description": "The billing term format in ISO-8601 duration format for recurring items."

        "hs_calculated_total_discount": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Calculated Total Discount",

        },
        "allow_buyer_selected_quantity": {
          "type": "boolean",
          "title": "Allow Buyer Selected Quantity",
          "description": "Boolean indicating if buyer can select quantity."
        },
        "hs_billing_start_delay_months": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Hs Billing Start Delay Months",
          "description": "The number of months billing should be delayed by."
```
