## HUBSPOT_RETRIEVE_LINE_ITEMS
Fetches a paginated list of HubSpot CRM line items, allowing selection of specific properties (including history), associated object IDs, and filtering by archive status; ensure property and association names are valid HubSpot internal names.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "RetrieveLineItemsRequest",
  "properties": {
    "after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "After",
      "description": "Pagination token from 'paging.next.after' of a previous response to fetch the subsequent page. Omit for the first request.",
      "human_parameter_name": "After",
      "human_parameter_description": "If you\u2019re continuing from a previous page, paste the 'after' token from that response to load the next results. Leave this blank for your first request."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "default": 10,
      "examples": [
        "10",
        "50",
        "100"
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of line items to return per page; controls response size. An API-defined upper limit may apply.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Limit",
      "human_parameter_description": "How many line items to return per page. Increase this to see more results at once; decrease it for quicker, lighter responses."
    },
    "archived": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Archived",
      "default": false,
      "examples": [
        "false",
        "true"
      ],
      "description": "Filter by archive status: `true` for archived only, `false` (default) for active only. Manages historical or current items.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Archived",
      "human_parameter_description": "Show only archived line items instead of active ones. Turn this on when you need to review or restore older records."
    },
    "properties": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Properties",
      "examples": [
        "[\"name\",\"price\",\"quantity\"]",
        "[\"hs_sku\",\"description\",\"createdate\"]"
      ],
      "description": "Property names to include for each line item (e.g., `[\"name\", \"price\"]`); customizes returned data. Non-existent properties are ignored. If omitted, a default set is returned.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Properties",
      "human_parameter_description": "List the fields you want to see for each line item (for example: name, price, quantity). Leave empty to use HubSpot\u2019s default set of fields."
    },
    "associations": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Associations",
      "examples": [
        [
          "deal",
          "product"
        ],
        [
          "ticket",
          "quote"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Object types (e.g., `[\"deal\", \"product\"]`) for which to retrieve associated IDs. Invalid types are ignored. Valid types depend on HubSpot data model.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Associations",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose the types of related records you want included as IDs (like deals or products). This helps you link line items to other objects you care about."
    },
    "propertiesWithHistory": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Properties With History",
      "examples": [
        [
          "status",
          "amount"
        ],
        [
          "deal_stage",
          "hs_line_item_price"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "Property names for which to include historical values (e.g., `[\"status\", \"amount\"]`); tracks changes. May reduce items returned per request due to increased payload.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Properties with History",
      "human_parameter_description": "Specify fields for which you also want to see past values and changes over time. Helpful for audits or tracking changes, but may return fewer items per page."
    }
  },
  "description": "Defines the parameters for the request to retrieve a list of line items."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_RETRIEVE_OBJECT_SCHEMA
Fetches the detailed schema definition for a specified, existing standard or custom HubSpot CRM object type; this action is read-only and does not create or modify schemas.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "RetrieveObjectSchemaRequest",
  "required": [
    "objectType"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "objectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "contacts",
        "companies",
        "deals",
        "2-1234567"
      ],
      "description": "Fully qualified name for standard HubSpot objects (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies') or unique object type ID for custom objects (e.g., 'p123456', '2-xxxxxxx'). Case-sensitive and must match an existing object type as defined in HubSpot.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Object Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Specify which HubSpot object you want the schema for. Enter a standard name like 'contacts' or the exact custom object type ID (e.g., '2-1234567') from your account."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `RetrieveObjectSchema`"
}
```

## HUBSPOT_RETRIEVE_OWNER_BY_ID_OR_USER_ID
Retrieves a specific HubSpot CRM owner by their ID, with options to specify ID type (owner or user) and to include archived records.

**Input schema:**

## HUBSPOT_RETRIEVE_PAGE_OF_CRM_OWNERS

**Input schema:**

```json
      ],

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Email",
      "examples": [
        "johndoe@example.com",

      "human_parameter_name": "Email Address",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter the email address of the owner you want to filter by. Use this to return results for a specific person only."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "default": 100,
      "examples": [
        "100",
        "50",
        "250"

      "human_parameter_name": "Page Limit",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set how many owners to return in one page of results. Higher values show more items at once; lower values can be quicker to load."

    "archived": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Archived",
      "default": false,
      "examples": [
        "true",
        "false"
      ],
      "description": "Set to `true` for archived owners, or `false` for active owners.",
```

## HUBSPOT_RETRIEVE_PIPELINE_STAGE_BY_ID
Fetches detailed properties and metadata (e.g., label, display order, custom properties) for a specific stage within a HubSpot CRM pipeline, identified by its `objectType`, `pipelineId`, and `stageId`.

**Input schema:**
```json
{

  "required": [
    "objectType",
    "pipelineId",
    "stageId"
  ],
  "properties": {

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Stage Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier (ID) of the specific pipeline stage to retrieve. This ID must be valid and exist within the specified pipeline.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Stage ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Provide the ID of the exact stage you want details for within the chosen pipeline. This identifies the stage to retrieve."
    },
    "objectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "deals",
        "tickets",
        "contacts"
      ],
      "description": "The type of CRM object associated with the pipeline (e.g., 'deals', 'tickets'). This is case-sensitive and determines which object-specific pipeline and stages are queried. Must be a valid HubSpot CRM object type.",
      "human_parameter_name": "CRM Object Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Select the type of records whose pipeline you want to access (for example, deals or tickets). This determines which pipelines and stages we search."
    },
    "pipelineId": {

      "title": "Pipeline Id",

}
```

## HUBSPOT_RETRIEVE_PIPELINE_STAGES
Fetches all stages for a specified HubSpot CRM object type and pipeline ID.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "RetrievePipelineStagesRequest",

    "objectType",
    "pipelineId"
  ],

    "objectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "deals",
        "tickets",
        "contacts",
        "companies"
      ],
      "description": "The CRM object type (e.g., deals, tickets) for which to retrieve pipeline stages; must support pipelines.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Object Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose the kind of record whose pipeline you want to view, like 'deals' or 'tickets'. This ensures we fetch the correct set of stages for that type."
    },
    "pipelineId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pipeline Id",
      "description": "The unique ID of the pipeline associated with the specified objectType whose stages are to be retrieved.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Pipeline ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the specific pipeline whose stages you want to see. Use the pipeline\u2019s ID from your CRM or one obtained from a previous pipeline list."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to retrieve all stages for a specific pipeline and object type."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_SEARCH_CONTACTS_BY_CRITERIA
Searches for HubSpot contacts using a text query, specific filter criteria (filters in a group are ANDed, groups are ORed), sorting, and pagination to retrieve selected properties.

## HUBSPOT_SEARCH_CRM_OBJECTS_BY_CRITERIA
Searches HubSpot CRM objects (e.g., 'contacts', 'companies') by `objectType` using complex criteria including filters, sorting, and pagination; property names used in filters, sorts, and returned properties must be valid for the specified `objectType`.

Searches for feedback submissions in HubSpot CRM using text query, filter groups, sorting, and pagination, returning specified properties.

## HUBSPOT_SEARCH_LINE_ITEMS_BY_CRITERIA
Searches HubSpot line items using criteria including filters, sorting, and pagination; `after` must be a valid cursor from a previous response, and `sorts`/`properties` must refer to valid line item property names.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SearchLineItemsByCriteriaRequest",
  "properties": {
    "after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "After",
      "examples": [
        "CURSOR_TOKEN_EXAMPLE"
      ],
      "description": "Pagination cursor from a prior response to fetch the next page of results. Leave empty for the first page.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Cursor",
      "human_parameter_description": "Paste the cursor token from the previous page to continue where you left off. Leave empty to start from the beginning."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "default": 10,
      "maximum": 200,
      "examples": [
        100
      ],
      "description": "Maximum number of line items to retrieve per page (default: 10, max: 200).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Limit",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose how many results to return in this request. Larger limits show more items at once; smaller limits can be faster. Defaults to 10."
    },
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "examples": [
        "printer cartridges"
      ],
      "description": "Optional search string applied across all searchable line item properties.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Search Query",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter keywords to search across line item fields. Use this for a quick, broad search."
    },
    "sorts": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },

      "default": [],
      "examples": [

          "name",
          "-createdate"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "List of property names for sorting results. Prepend '-' for descending order. Defaults to creation date ascending if omitted.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Sorts",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set how to order the results using property names (add '-' for descending). Leave empty to sort by creation date (oldest first)."
    },
    "properties": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {

      },

                },

                  "type": "array",

                  },
                  "title": "Values",

                  ],
                  "type": "string",

                  "examples": [

                  ],
                  "description": "Filtering operator (e.g., `EQ`, `BETWEEN`) defining the comparison logic.",
                  "human_parameter_name": "Operator",
                  "human_parameter_description": "Select how to compare your value(s) to the chosen property (e.g., equals, greater than, between). This controls the filter logic."

        },
        "description": "Groups multiple filters; line items must match all filters (AND logic) within this group."
      },
      "title": "Filter Groups",
      "default": [],
      "description": "List of filter groups. Line items must match all filters in at least one group (filters within a group are ANDed; groups are ORed). Leave empty to return all line items.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Filter Groups",
      "human_parameter_description": "Define one or more groups of filters; items matching any group will be included. Leave empty to search all line items without filtering."
    }
  },
  "description": "Defines the complete search criteria, including filtering, sorting, and pagination, for HubSpot line items."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_SEARCH_TICKETS
Searches for HubSpot tickets using flexible criteria and filters.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SearchTicketsByCriteriaRequest",
  "properties": {
    "after": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "After",
      "description": "Cursor token for pagination to get the next page of results."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Limit",
      "default": 5,
      "description": "Maximum number of tickets to return in the response."
    },
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Query",
      "examples": [
        "urgent issue",
        "billing problem"
      ],
      "description": "Text search query to find tickets by content or subject.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Search Query",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter keywords or phrases to find tickets by their subject or content. Use terms related to the issue so we can surface the most relevant tickets."
    },
    "sorts": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Sorts",
      "default": [],
      "description": "List of sort criteria for ordering the results."
    },
    "properties": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Properties",
      "default": [
        "subject",
        "content",
        "hs_ticket_priority",
        "hs_pipeline_stage"
      ],
      "description": "Ticket properties to include in the response. Supports both standard and custom properties.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Ticket Properties",
      "human_parameter_description": "Pick which details you want returned for each ticket (for example, subject or priority). You can also include custom property internal names."
    },
    "filterGroups": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "FilterGroupsRequest",
        "properties": {
          "filters": {
            "type": "array",
            "items": {
              "type": "object",
              "title": "FiltersRequest",
              "required": [
                "propertyName",
                "operator"
              ],
              "properties": {
                "value": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Value",
                  "description": "The value to filter on."
                },
                "values": {
                  "type": "array",
                  "items": {
                    "type": "string"
                  },
                  "title": "Values",
                  "description": "List of values to match against for multi-value filters."
                },
                "operator": {
                  "enum": [
                    "EQ",
                    "NEQ",
                    "LT",
                    "LTE",
                    "GT",
                    "GTE",
                    "BETWEEN",
                    "IN",
                    "NOT_IN",
                    "HAS_PROPERTY",
                    "NOT_HAS_PROPERTY",
                    "CONTAINS_TOKEN",
                    "NOT_CONTAINS_TOKEN"
                  ],
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Operator",
                  "description": "The filter operator (e.g., EQ, GT, LT, CONTAINS)."
                },
                "highValue": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "High Value",
                  "description": "The upper bound value for range filters."
                },
                "propertyName": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "title": "Property Name",
                  "description": "The name of the property to filter on."
                }
              }
            },
            "title": "Filters",
            "default": [],
            "description": "List of filters within this filter group."
          }
        }
      },
      "title": "Filter Groups",
      "default": [],
      "description": "Groups of filters to apply to the ticket search."
    },
    "custom_properties": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Custom Properties",
      "default": [],
      "description": "List of custom property names to include in the response."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for searching ticket objects in HubSpot with various criteria."
```

## HUBSPOT_SET_CALL_RECORDING_SETTINGS
Configures the URL (`urlToRetrieveAuthedRecording`) that HubSpot uses to retrieve call recordings for a specified third-party calling app (`appId`). The URL must contain a %s placeholder which HubSpot replaces with the engagement's externalId. The calling app must be an existing calling extension app integrated with the HubSpot account.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "SetCallRecordingSettingsRequest",
  "required": [
    "appId",
    "urlToRetrieveAuthedRecording"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "appId": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "App Id",
      "description": "Unique identifier for the third-party calling app integration in HubSpot CRM whose recording settings will be modified.",
      "human_parameter_name": "App ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the calling app in your HubSpot account that you want to update. This tells HubSpot which integration's recording settings to apply."
    },
    "urlToRetrieveAuthedRecording": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Url To Retrieve Authed Recording",
      "examples": [
        "https://myapplication.com/api/recordings/%s",
        "https://example.com/calls/%s/recording"
      ],
      "description": "Endpoint URL for HubSpot to retrieve call recordings; must contain %s placeholder which HubSpot will replace with the engagement's externalId, and must serve recordings with authentication if required.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Recording URL",
      "human_parameter_description": "The secure URL where HubSpot retrieves call recordings. IMPORTANT: Must contain %s as a placeholder - HubSpot replaces it with the engagement's external ID when fetching recordings. Example: https://yourapp.com/api/recordings/%s"
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `SetCallRecordingSettings`"
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "SetCallRecordingSettingsResponse": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "SetCallRecordingSettingsResponse",
      "required": [
        "urlToRetrieveAuthedRecording"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "urlToRetrieveAuthedRecording": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Url To Retrieve Authed Recording",
          "description": "The URL used to retrieve authenticated call recordings. This is the endpoint URL that was registered or updated for the calling app."
        }
      },
      "description": "Response schema for `SetCallRecordingSettings`"
    }
  },
  "title": "SetCallRecordingSettingsResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "urlToRetrieveAuthedRecording"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "urlToRetrieveAuthedRecording": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Url To Retrieve Authed Recording",
          "description": "The URL used to retrieve authenticated call recordings. This is the endpoint URL that was registered or updated for the calling app."
        }
      },
      "description": "Data from the action execution"
    },

    },

      "description": "Whether or not the action execution was successful or not"
    }
  }
}
```

## HUBSPOT_START_IMPORT
Call this action to start an asynchronous data import into HubSpot CRM using uploaded files and a detailed `importRequest` JSON configuration, ensuring this JSON correctly maps file columns to HubSpot properties and files align with these mappings.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "StartImportRequest",
  "properties": {
    "files": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "FileType",
      "format": "binary",
      "required": [
        "name",
        "content"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "name": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Name",
          "description": "File name, contains extension to indetify the file type"
        },
        "content": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Content",
          "format": "binary",
          "description": "File content in base64"
        }
      },
      "description": "The binary content of the file(s) to be imported. Supported formats typically include CSV, XLSX, and XLS. Ensure the file structure aligns with the mappings defined in `importRequest`.",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "human_parameter_name": "Files",
      "human_parameter_description": "Upload the file or files you want to import into HubSpot, such as a CSV or Excel spreadsheet. Pick the exact files that contain the data you want to bring in."
    },
    "importRequest": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Import Request",
      "examples": [
        "{\"name\":\"New Contacts Import\",\"dateFormat\":\"MONTH_DAY_YEAR\",\"files\":[{\"fileName\":\"contacts.csv\",\"fileFormat\":\"CSV\",\"fileImportPage\":{\"columnMappings\":[{\"columnObjectTypeId\":\"CONTACT\",\"columnName\":\"First Name\",\"propertyName\":\"firstname\"},{\"columnObjectTypeId\":\"CONTACT\",\"columnName\":\"Last Name\",\"propertyName\":\"lastname\"},{\"columnObjectTypeId\":\"CONTACT\",\"columnName\":\"Email Address\",\"propertyName\":\"email\"}]}}]}"
      ],
      "description": "A JSON string specifying the configuration for the import process. This configuration dictates how data from the uploaded file(s) is mapped and imported into HubSpot. Key properties include `name` (a descriptive name for the import, e.g., \"Q3 Contact Import\"), `dateFormat` (e.g., 'MONTH_DAY_YEAR', 'DAY_MONTH_YEAR'), `importOperations` (defines if the import should create and update, only create, or only update records, e.g., 'CREATE_AND_UPDATE'), and `files` (an array detailing each file, its format, and `columnMappings`). The `columnMappings` are crucial as they map spreadsheet columns to HubSpot CRM object properties (e.g., map 'Email Address' column to 'CONTACT' object's 'email' property).",
      "human_parameter_name": "Import Request",
      "human_parameter_description": "Paste the JSON settings that tell HubSpot how to map your file columns to fields and whether to create or update records. This controls how your data is imported."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for initiating a data import process in HubSpot."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_UPDATE_A_MARKETING_EMAIL
Updates properties of an existing marketing email identified by its `emailId`; unspecified fields retain their current values.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateAMarketingEmailRequest",
  "required": [
    "emailId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "name": {

      "title": "LanguageEnm",
      "examples": [
        "en",

    "publishDate": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Publish Date",
      "format": "date-time",
      "examples": [
        "2024-07-15T14:30:00Z"
      ],
      "description": "The scheduled publication date and time for the email in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2023-12-31T10:00:00Z'). Used for scheduled emails."
    },
    "subcategory": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Subcategory",
      "examples": [
        "Product Updates",
        "Webinar Invitations"
      ],
      "description": "The subcategory of the email, often used for organization (e.g., 'newsletter', 'promotional')."
    },
    "activeDomain": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Active Domain",
      "examples": [
        "marketing.example.com"
      ],
      "description": "The domain from which this email will be sent (e.g., 'info.example.com'). Must be a connected sending domain in HubSpot."
    },
    "rssData__url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Rss Data  Url",
      "description": "The URL of the external RSS feed if not using a HubSpot blog."
    },
    "from__replyTo": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "From  Reply To",
      "examples": [
        "newsletter@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "The email address used as the 'From' address and default 'Reply-To' address. Must be a verified address in HubSpot."
    },
    "sendOnPublish": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Send On Publish",
      "description": "If `true` and the email state is set to 'PUBLISHED', the email will be sent immediately. If `false` for a 'PUBLISHED' state, it implies it was already sent or is a template."
    },
    "businessUnitId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Business Unit Id",
      "examples": [
        "123"
      ],
      "description": "The ID of the business unit this email belongs to. Requires the Business Units add-on for HubSpot."
    },
    "from__fromName": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "From  From Name",
      "examples": [
        "ACME Corp News"
      ],
      "description": "The sender's name as it appears in the recipient's inbox (e.g., 'Marketing Team')."
    },
    "rssData__timing": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Rss Data  Timing",
      "description": "A dictionary defining the scheduling for RSS emails (e.g., time of day, day of week/month). The structure depends on `blogEmailType`.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": true
      }
    },
    "testing__testId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Testing  Test Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier of the A/B test, if applicable."
    },
    "content__widgets": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Content  Widgets",
      "description": "A dictionary specifying the configuration and content of various widgets (modules) used in the email.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": true
      }
    },
    "webversion__slug": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Webversion  Slug",
      "description": "The URL slug for the web version of the email (e.g., 'july-newsletter-2024')."
    },
    "testing__abStatus": {
      "enum": [
        "master",
        "variant",
        "loser_variant",
        "mab_master",
        "mab_variant",
        "automated_master",
        "automated_variant",
        "automated_loser_variant"
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "title": "AbstatusEnm",
      "description": "Status of the AB test (e.g., 'master', 'variant')."
    },
    "webversion__title": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Webversion  Title",
      "examples": [
        "Our Latest News - Web Version"
      ],
      "description": "The title displayed in the browser tab for the web version of the email."
    },
    "content__flexAreas": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Content  Flex Areas",
      "description": "A dictionary defining content for flexible column areas within drag-and-drop email templates.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "object",
        "additionalProperties": true
      }
    },
    "webversion__domain": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Webversion  Domain",
      "description": "The domain to be used for the web version of this email. If not specified, the default portal domain is used."
    },
    "from__customReplyTo": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "From  Custom Reply To",
      "examples": [
        "support@example.com"
      ],
      "description": "A custom email address for replies. If set, this overrides the main `replyTo` address for replies."
    },
```

## HUBSPOT_UPDATE_BATCH_FEEDBACK_SUBMISSIONS
Updates a batch of HubSpot feedback submissions; property keys must be existing internal HubSpot names and values must be correctly formatted strings.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateBatchFeedbackSubmissionsRequest",
  "required": [
    "inputs"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "inputs": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "InputsRequest",
        "required": [
          "id",
          "properties"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Id",
            "examples": [
              "1234567890",
              "external_feedback_abc_001"
            ],
            "description": "Unique identifier of the feedback submission, either HubSpot object ID or value of `idProperty`.",
            "human_parameter_name": "Feedback ID",
            "human_parameter_description": "The identifier of the feedback submission you want to update. Use the HubSpot record ID or the value of the alternate field you provided in 'Alternate ID'."
          },
          "idProperty": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Id Property",
            "examples": [
              "my_custom_external_id_field"
            ],
            "description": "Name of an alternate unique property to identify the submission; if used, `id` must be the value of this property.",
            "human_parameter_name": "Alternate ID",
            "human_parameter_description": "If you use a custom field to identify a submission, enter that field's name here (for example, an external ID). This lets you match the record using that field instead of the default HubSpot ID."
          },
          "properties": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Properties",
            "examples": [
              "{\"hs_feedback_rating\": \"5\", \"hs_feedback_comments\": \"Service was excellent!\"}",
              "{\"hs_csat_rating\": \"10\", \"hs_follow_up_needed\": \"true\"}"
            ],
            "description": "Properties to update; keys are internal HubSpot property names, values are new string values.",
            "additionalProperties": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "human_parameter_name": "Update Properties",
            "human_parameter_description": "Specify which fields to update and their new values for this submission. Provide each property name with the value you want it to have after the update."
          }
        },
        "description": "Defines an individual feedback submission update within a batch."
      },
      "title": "Inputs",
      "description": "List of feedback submissions to update, each specifying its identifier and new property values.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Submission List",
      "human_parameter_description": "Provide the list of feedback submissions to update. For each one, include its ID details and the properties you want to change."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to update a batch of feedback submissions."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_UPDATE_BATCH_OF_OBJECTS_BY_IDOR_PROPERTY_VALUES
Performs a batch update on a valid `objectType` where properties are writeable and any `idProperty` used is designated unique; updates can be partial.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateBatchOfObjectsByIdorPropertyValuesRequest",
  "required": [
    "objectType",
    "inputs"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "inputs": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "InputsRequest",
        "required": [
          "id",
          "properties"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Id",
            "examples": [
              "1234567890",
              "john.doe@example.com",
              "EXTID_001"
            ],
            "description": "Unique identifier of the object to update, either its HubSpot ID or the value of the unique property specified in `idProperty`.",
            "human_parameter_name": "Object ID",
            "human_parameter_description": "Provide the value that identifies the record you want to update. This can be the HubSpot ID or the value of the unique property you specified above (for example, an email address or external ID)."
          },
          "idProperty": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Id Property",
            "examples": [
              "email",
              "my_custom_external_id"
            ],
            "description": "Name of the unique property for object identification if `id` is not the HubSpot object ID; if omitted, `id` is assumed to be the HubSpot object ID.",
            "human_parameter_name": "ID Property",
            "human_parameter_description": "If you're not using the HubSpot ID, enter the unique property you use to identify records (like an email or external ID). This tells us how to find the record you want to update."
          },
          "properties": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Properties",
            "description": "Dictionary of property internal names to their new values for the update.",
            "additionalProperties": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "human_parameter_description": "Set the fields you want to change and their new values. Use the internal property names (like firstname or lifecycle_stage) and the values you want to apply."
          }
        },
        "description": "A single object to be updated within the batch operation."
      },
      "title": "Inputs",
      "description": "List of objects to update, each detailing the object and its property changes. Max 100 objects per batch.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Inputs",
      "human_parameter_description": "Add the list of records to update and the changes for each one. You can include up to 100 items in a single batch."
    },
    "objectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "contacts",
        "companies",
        "deals",
        "tickets",
        "p_mycustomobject"
      ],
      "description": "Case-sensitive CRM object type to be updated in bulk (e.g., 'contacts', 'p_customobject'), determining the target object set.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Object Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose which type of records you want to update (for example, contacts, companies, deals, tickets, or a custom object). Use the exact internal object name."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request payload for batch updating CRM objects."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_UPDATE_CALLING_APP_RECORDING_SETTINGS
Updates the recording settings, such as the URL for retrieving authenticated recordings, for a specific calling extension app identified by its `appId`.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateCallingAppRecordingSettingsRequest",
  "required": [
    "appId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "appId": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "App Id",
      "description": "The unique identifier for the calling app.",
      "human_parameter_name": "App ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the calling app you want to update. This tells us which app\u2019s recording settings to change."
    },
    "urlToRetrieveAuthedRecording": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Url To Retrieve Authed Recording",
      "description": "URL HubSpot uses to retrieve call recordings requiring authentication from the calling app.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Authentication URL",
      "human_parameter_description": "The secure URL your app provides for HubSpot to download protected call recordings. Include this if your recordings require authentication."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `UpdateCallingAppRecordingSettings`"
}
```

**Output schema:**
```json

  "$defs": {

      "title": "UpdateCallingAppRecordingSettingsResponse",

        "urlToRetrieveAuthedRecording"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "urlToRetrieveAuthedRecording": {
          "type": "string",
          "title": "Url To Retrieve Authed Recording",
          "description": "The updated URL used to retrieve authenticated call recordings. This is the endpoint URL that was registered or updated for the calling app."
        }
      },
      "description": "Response schema for `UpdateCallingAppRecordingSettings`"
    }
  },
  "title": "UpdateCallingAppRecordingSettingsResponseWrapper",
  "required": [
    "data",
    "successful"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "data": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Data",
      "required": [
        "urlToRetrieveAuthedRecording"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "urlToRetrieveAuthedRecording": {
          "type": "string",

      },
```

## HUBSPOT_UPDATE_CALLING_EXTENSION_SETTINGS
Updates settings (e.g., display name, UI URL/dimensions, feature flags) for an existing calling extension app, identified by `appId`.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateCallingExtensionSettingsRequest",
  "required": [
    "appId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Url",
      "examples": [
        "https://myapp.com/calling-ui",
        "https://cdn.example.com/caller/index.html"
      ],
      "description": "URL to the phone/calling UI, which should be built using the HubSpot Calling SDK.",
      "human_parameter_name": "UI URL",
      "human_parameter_description": "The web address of your calling UI that HubSpot will load. Use the URL where your Calling SDK-based interface is hosted."
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Name",
      "examples": [
        "My Awesome Dialer",
        "Sales Caller Pro"
      ],
      "description": "User-facing display name of the calling service.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Display Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "The display name users will see for your calling service in HubSpot. Pick a clear, friendly name."
    },
    "appId": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "App Id",
      "examples": [
        "12345",
        "67890"
      ],
      "description": "The unique ID of the target app whose calling extension settings are being modified.",
      "human_parameter_name": "App ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique identifier of the calling extension app you want to update. This tells us which app's settings to change."
    },
    "width": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Width",
      "examples": [
        "400",
        "350"
      ],
      "description": "Target width (pixels) of the iframe embedding the phone/calling UI.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Width",
      "human_parameter_description": "How wide you want the calling window to be, in pixels. Adjust this to fit your UI."
    },
    "height": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Height",
      "examples": [
        "600",
        "550"
      ],
      "description": "Target height (pixels) of the iframe embedding the phone/calling UI.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Height",
      "human_parameter_description": "How tall you want the calling window to be, in pixels. Adjust this to fit your UI."
    },
    "isReady": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Is Ready",
      "examples": [
        "true",
        "false"
      ],
      "description": "If `true`, the calling service appears as an option under the 'Call' action in contact records.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Is Ready",
      "human_parameter_description": "Show your calling service as an option under the Call action in HubSpot. Turn this on when the integration is ready for users."
    },
    "supportsCustomObjects": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Supports Custom Objects",
      "examples": [
        "true",
        "false"
      ],
      "description": "Indicates if the calling service is compatible with HubSpot's engagement V2 service and custom objects.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Supports Custom Objects",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose whether your calling service works with HubSpot custom objects and the newer engagement features. Turn this on if your integration can log calls to custom objects."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `UpdateCallingExtensionSettings`"
}
```

## HUBSPOT_UPDATE_CAMPAIGN
Partially updates specific, writable properties of an existing HubSpot marketing campaign identified by `campaignGuid`; an empty string value in `properties` clears a property.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateCampaignRequest",
  "required": [
    "campaignGuid",
    "properties"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "properties": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Properties",
      "examples": [
        "{\"hs_name\": \"New Q1 Product Launch\", \"hs_campaign_status\": \"active\"}",
        "{\"hs_notes\": \"Updated campaign strategy\", \"hs_audience\": \"Enterprise customers\"}",
        "{\"hs_start_date\": \"2026-02-01\", \"hs_end_date\": \"2026-03-31\"}"
      ],
      "description": "Dictionary of campaign properties to update. Keys are internal property names (e.g., hs_name, hs_campaign_status, hs_start_date), values are their new string values. Values overwrite existing ones. Attempting to update read-only or non-existent properties will result in an error. To clear a property, set it to an empty string.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "human_parameter_name": "Properties",
      "human_parameter_description": "Specify the campaign fields you want to change and their new values. Valid properties include: hs_name (name), hs_campaign_status (status like 'active' or 'completed'), hs_start_date/hs_end_date (dates in YYYY-MM-DD format), hs_notes (notes), hs_audience (target audience), hs_utm (UTM parameter), hs_currency_code (currency like 'USD'), and hs_color_hex (color code). Include only the fields you want to update; leave out anything you don't want to change. Set a property to an empty string to clear it."
    },
    "campaignGuid": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Campaign Guid",
      "examples": [
        "5c5a77e2-c378-4434-9b13-3a9c74c5a398"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier (UUID) of the HubSpot marketing campaign to update.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Campaign ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter the unique ID of the HubSpot campaign you want to update. You can copy this from the campaign's details page or use the ID returned by a previous create or list action."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `UpdateCampaign`"
}
```

## HUBSPOT_UPDATE_CRM_PROPERTY
Updates attributes of an existing HubSpot CRM property, identified by its `objectType` and `propertyName`; only provided fields are modified, and changing a property's `type` can cause data loss if incompatible with existing data.

## HUBSPOT_UPDATE_DEAL
Updates properties for an existing HubSpot deal.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "PartiallyUpdateDealByIdRequest",
  "required": [
    "dealId",
    "properties"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "dealId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Deal Id",
      "examples": [
        "12345",
        "67890"
      ],
      "description": "Unique HubSpot identifier for the deal to be updated.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Deal ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique ID of the HubSpot deal you want to update. You can find it in the deal's URL or from the results of a previous search or list."
    },
    "properties": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Properties",
      "examples": [
        "{\"dealname\": \"Updated Deal\", \"amount\": \"50000\"}",
        "{\"dealstage\": \"closedwon\", \"closedate\": \"2024-12-31\"}",
        "{\"dealstage\": \"12345678\", \"pipeline\": \"default\"}"
      ],
      "description": "Deal properties to update. Must contain at least one property. Keys are internal HubSpot property names; use empty string to clear a property. IMPORTANT - Some properties require specific internal HubSpot IDs: (1) 'dealstage' requires a valid pipeline stage ID (e.g., 'closedwon', 'closedlost', or numeric IDs like '12345678'). Stage IDs are NOT human-readable labels - retrieve valid IDs via GET /crm/v3/pipelines/deals. (2) 'pipeline' requires a valid pipeline ID (e.g., 'default' for the default Sales Pipeline, or a custom pipeline ID). (3) 'hubspot_owner_id' requires a valid HubSpot user/owner ID. Common text/numeric properties: dealname (string), amount (decimal string), closedate (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601), description (string), deal_currency_code (3-letter currency code like 'USD'). CRITICAL for enum/select properties: Custom dropdown/select properties (e.g., 'how_did_you_hear_about_heard') have case-sensitive allowed values. You MUST use the exact value as defined in HubSpot (e.g., 'Google search' NOT 'Google Search'). Use HUBSPOT_READ_A_CRM_PROPERTY_BY_NAME to retrieve valid enum options for any property.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "human_parameter_name": "Properties",
      "human_parameter_description": "The deal fields you want to change and their new values. Include only the properties you want to update; everything else will stay the same. Note: For 'dealstage', use the internal stage ID (like 'closedwon', 'closedlost', or a numeric ID), NOT human-readable stage names. For enum/select properties (custom dropdowns), values are CASE-SENSITIVE - use exactly the value defined in HubSpot. Use HUBSPOT_RETRIEVE_ALL_PIPELINES_FOR_SPECIFIED_OBJECT_TYPE to get valid pipeline and stage IDs, or HUBSPOT_READ_A_CRM_PROPERTY_BY_NAME to get valid options for any property."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for updating a deal by ID."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_UPDATE_DEALS
Updates multiple HubSpot deals in a single batch operation.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateBatchOfDealsRequest",
  "required": [
    "inputs"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "inputs": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "InputsRequest",
        "required": [
          "id"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Id",
            "examples": [
              "12345",
              "67890"
            ],
            "description": "The HubSpot Deal ID to be updated.",
            "human_parameter_name": "Deal ID",
            "human_parameter_description": "The unique ID of the deal you want to update. You can copy it from the deal's URL or from a previous list or search."
          },
          "properties": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Properties",
            "examples": [
              {
                "amount": "5000",
                "dealstage": "closedwon"
              },
              {
                "dealstage": "qualifiedtobuy"
              },
              {
                "dealname": "Updated Deal Name",
                "dealstage": "contractsent"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Properties to update. Only include changes. IMPORTANT for 'dealstage': Use lowercase internal stage IDs, not display names. Default pipeline valid values: 'appointmentscheduled', 'qualifiedtobuy', 'presentationscheduled', 'decisionmakerboughtin', 'contractsent', 'closedwon', 'closedlost'. Custom pipelines use numeric stage IDs (e.g., '2317386479'). Common display names like 'Closed Won' are automatically converted to internal IDs.",
            "additionalProperties": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "human_parameter_description": "The fields and new values you want to change for this deal. For 'dealstage', use internal stage IDs like 'closedwon' or 'qualifiedtobuy' (not display names like 'Closed Won'). Custom pipeline stages use numeric IDs."
          }
        },
        "description": "Individual deal update definition for a batch operation."
      },
      "title": "Inputs",
      "description": "List of deal update operations.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Deal Updates",
      "human_parameter_description": "Add the deal updates you want to perform in this batch. Each item should include the deal's ID and the fields you want to change."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to update a batch of deals."
}
```

**Input schema:**

```json
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id Property",

  },

}
```

## HUBSPOT_UPDATE_EMAILS
Updates multiple HubSpot emails in a single batch operation.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateABatchOfEmailsRequest",

    "inputs"
  ],

            ],

      "title": "Inputs",
      "description": "List of email update operations.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Email Updates",
```

## HUBSPOT_UPDATE_EVENT_TEMPLATE
Updates an existing HubSpot event template's name, display templates, and tokens; providing `tokens` replaces the entire existing list, and the `id` in the request body must match `eventTemplateId` in the path.

**Input schema:**

## HUBSPOT_UPDATE_FEEDBACK_SUBMISSION
Partially updates writable properties of an existing HubSpot Feedback Submission, identified by its `feedbackSubmissionId` (which can be an internal object ID, or a unique property value if `idProperty` is specified).

**Input schema:**

## HUBSPOT_UPDATE_LINE_ITEM
Partially updates specified properties of an existing HubSpot Line Item, identified by `lineItemId` (as HubSpot object ID or value of `idProperty` if used); new values overwrite existing ones, and an empty string clears a property.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateLineItemRequest",
  "required": [
    "lineItemId",
    "properties"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "idProperty": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Id Property",
      "examples": [
        "hs_sku",
        "my_custom_unique_identifier_property"
      ],
      "description": "Name of a unique property on the Line Item used for identification instead of HubSpot object ID. If used, `lineItemId` must contain this property's value. Must be a valid, unique-value property for Line Items.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Identifier Property",
      "human_parameter_description": "Use this if you want to identify the line item by a unique property instead of its HubSpot ID. Provide the internal name of that unique property (for example, hs_sku)."
    },
    "lineItemId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Line Item Id",
      "examples": [
        "123456789",
        "SKU-007-BLUE"
      ],
      "description": "Identifier for the Line Item to update: HubSpot object ID by default, or the value of the unique property if `idProperty` is specified. Must be non-empty.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Line Item ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The specific line item you want to update. Enter its HubSpot ID, or if you set an Identifier Property below, provide that property's value for the item."
    },
    "properties": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Properties",
      "examples": [
        "{\"quantity\": \"3\", \"price\": \"250.00\"}",
        "{\"name\": \"Updated Special Order Item\", \"description\": \"Customer requested specific modifications.\"}"
      ],
      "description": "Properties to update. Keys are internal HubSpot line item property names (e.g., 'quantity', 'price'), values are new string values. Example: `{'quantity': '5', 'name': 'New Product Name'}`.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "human_parameter_name": "Properties",
      "human_parameter_description": "The line item fields you want to change and their new values. Use internal property names as keys (like quantity or price) and provide the updated values."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `UpdateLineItem`"
}
```

## HUBSPOT_UPDATE_LINE_ITEMS
Updates a batch of existing HubSpot CRM line items in a single operation, identifying each by its primary ID or a unique `idProperty` (which must be a unique identifier property in HubSpot), and modifies their specified properties.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateLineItemsRequest",
  "required": [
    "inputs"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "inputs": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "InputsRequest",
        "required": [
          "id",
          "properties"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Id",
            "examples": [
              "1234567890",
              "PROD-XYZ-001"
            ],
            "description": "Identifier of the line item to update. If `idProperty` is specified, this is its value; otherwise, it's the line item's primary object ID.",
            "human_parameter_name": "Line Item ID",
            "human_parameter_description": "The value that identifies the line item you want to update. Use the item's primary ID or, if you chose an ID Property, enter that property's value (for example, the SKU)."
          },
          "idProperty": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Id Property",
            "examples": [
              "sku",
              "custom_unique_id_field"
            ],
            "description": "Name of a unique property for identifying the line item. If provided, `id` must be this property's value; otherwise, `id` is the line item's primary object ID.",
            "human_parameter_name": "ID Property",
            "human_parameter_description": "The property you want to use to identify the line item instead of its main ID (for example, 'sku'). If you set this, enter that property's value in the Line Item ID field."
          },
          "properties": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Properties",
            "examples": [
              "{\"quantity\": \"10\", \"price\": \"25.99\"}",
              "{\"name\": \"Updated Line Item Name\", \"description\": \"New description\"}"
            ],
            "description": "Dictionary of properties to update for the line item: keys are internal property names, values are their new values.",
            "additionalProperties": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "human_parameter_name": "Properties",
            "human_parameter_description": "The fields you want to update for this line item as key-value pairs (like quantity, price, or name). Include only the fields you want to change."
          }
        },
        "description": "Defines a single line item update operation within a batch request."
      },
      "title": "Inputs",
      "examples": [
        "[{\"id\": \"123\", \"properties\": {\"quantity\": \"5\", \"price\": \"10.00\"}}, {\"idProperty\": \"sku\", \"id\": \"SKU12345\", \"properties\": {\"name\": \"Super Widget\"}}]"
      ],
      "description": "A list of objects, where each object defines a line item to be updated and its new property values. Each object must conform to the InputsRequest schema.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Line Items",
      "human_parameter_description": "Add one or more line item updates. For each one, specify how to identify the item and the fields you want to change."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for the action to update a batch of line items. Contains a list of update operations."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_UPDATE_OBJECT_SCHEMA
Updates an existing custom object schema's metadata in HubSpot, such as its description, labels, display properties, required properties, searchable properties, and restorability, for a specified `objectType` that must already exist.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateObjectSchemaRequest",
  "required": [
    "objectType"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "objectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "p12345678_mycustomobject",
        "2-1234567"
      ],
      "description": "The fully qualified name or object type ID that uniquely identifies the custom object schema to be updated. This must correspond to an existing schema in your HubSpot account.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Object Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique name or ID of the custom object schema you want to update. Use the fully qualified name (e.g., p12345678_mycustomobject) or the object type ID (e.g., 2-1234567)."
    },
    "restorable": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Restorable",
      "examples": [
        true,
        false
      ],
      "description": "A boolean indicating whether records of this object type can be restored from the recycle bin if deleted. Set to `true` to enable restoration, `false` otherwise.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Restorable",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose whether deleted records of this object can be restored from the recycle bin. Turn this on if you want the ability to recover deleted records."
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Description",
      "examples": [
        "Schema for tracking project milestones.",
        "Defines the structure for customer support tickets."
      ],
      "description": "A human-readable description for the custom object schema itself.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Description",
      "human_parameter_description": "A plain-language summary of what this object represents. Update this to help teammates understand the purpose of the object; leave blank to keep the current text."
    },
    "labels__plural": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Labels  Plural",
      "examples": [
        "Projects",
        "Tasks",
        "Shipments"
      ],
      "description": "The plural display name for the custom object type (e.g., 'Companies', 'Tickets'), used in the HubSpot UI for multiple records of this type.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Labels Plural",
      "human_parameter_description": "The plural label shown in the UI for multiple records (e.g., 'Projects'). Update this to control how lists of records are named."
    },
    "labels__singular": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Labels  Singular",
      "examples": [
        "Project",
        "Task",
        "Shipment"
      ],
      "description": "The singular display name for the custom object type (e.g., 'Company', 'Ticket'), used in the HubSpot UI for a single record of this type.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Labels Singular",
      "human_parameter_description": "The singular label shown in the UI for one record (e.g., 'Project'). Update this to control how an individual record is named."
    },
    "requiredProperties": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Required Properties",
      "examples": [
        [
          "name",
          "owner_id"
        ],
        [
          "ticket_subject"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "A list of internal names of properties that are mandatory when creating a new record of this object type.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Required Properties",
      "human_parameter_description": "The properties that must be filled in when creating a new record of this object. Provide internal property names to enforce required fields."
    },
    "searchableProperties": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Searchable Properties",
      "examples": [
        [
          "company_name",
          "contact_name"
        ],
        [
          "product_sku"
        ]
      ],
      "description": "A list of internal names of properties that will be indexed and searchable within HubSpot's product search for this object type.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Searchable Properties",
      "human_parameter_description": "The properties you want to make searchable in HubSpot for this object. Provide internal property names."
    },
    "primaryDisplayProperty": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Primary Display Property",
      "examples": [
        "name",
        "ticket_id",
        "company_domain"
      ],
      "description": "The internal name of the property that will serve as the primary display identifier on the HubSpot record page for this object type. This is typically a unique identifier like a name or ID.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Primary Display Property",
      "human_parameter_description": "The main property that should appear as the record\u2019s title. Provide the internal name of the field you want to use."
    },
    "secondaryDisplayProperties": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "title": "Secondary Display Properties",
      "examples": [
        "[\"contact_email\", \"last_modified_date\"]",
        "[\"deal_stage\", \"deal_amount\"]"
      ],
      "description": "A list of internal names of properties to be displayed as secondary information on the HubSpot record page for this object type. These properties appear below the primary display property.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Secondary Display Properties",
      "human_parameter_description": "The properties you want to show as secondary details on each record (beneath the primary field). Provide internal property names, or leave empty to keep the current selection."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `UpdateObjectSchema`"
}
```

## HUBSPOT_UPDATE_PIPELINE
Partially updates a CRM pipeline's label, display order, or restores an archived pipeline by setting `archived` to `false`.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdatePipelineRequest",
  "required": [
    "objectType",
    "pipelineId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "label": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Label",
      "description": "Unique label for the pipeline for UI organization.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Pipeline Label",
      "human_parameter_description": "The name you want displayed for this pipeline. Pick something clear so users can easily recognize it in the interface."
    },
    "archived": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Archived",
      "description": "To restore an archived pipeline, set to `false`. Other uses (e.g., archiving an active pipeline or setting `false` for an already active one) will result in a `400 Bad Request`.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Archived Status",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set this to false if you want to restore an archived pipeline. Otherwise, leave it empty unless you specifically intend to change the archive status."
    },
    "objectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "deals",
        "tickets",
        "contacts"
      ],
      "description": "Type of CRM object the pipeline is associated with (e.g., 'deals', 'tickets').",
      "human_parameter_name": "CRM Object Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose the type of record whose pipeline you want to update, like deals or tickets. This tells us which pipeline category to modify."
    },
    "pipelineId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pipeline Id",
      "description": "Unique identifier of the pipeline to update.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Pipeline ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The unique ID of the specific pipeline you want to change. You can copy this from your CRM\u2019s pipeline settings or a previous list call."
    },
    "displayOrder": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Display Order",
      "description": "Display order for the pipeline. Pipelines with the same order are sorted alphabetically by label.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Display Order",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose where this pipeline should appear in the list; lower numbers show first. Use this to control the order users see pipelines in the UI."
    },
    "validateReferencesBeforeDelete": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Validate References Before Delete",
      "default": false,
      "description": "If `true`, verify existing references to pipeline stages before updates that could delete or alter them.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Validate References",
      "human_parameter_description": "Turn this on to check for other items that depend on the pipeline\u2019s stages before making changes. It helps prevent breaking linked records."
    },
    "validateDealStageUsagesBeforeDelete": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Validate Deal Stage Usages Before Delete",
      "default": false,
      "description": "For deal pipelines only: if `true`, check if any deals use stages affected by the update.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Validate Deal Usages",
      "human_parameter_description": "For deal pipelines, enable this to verify whether existing deals are using stages you\u2019re about to change or remove. This helps avoid disrupting active deals."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `UpdatePipeline`"
}
```

```json
            "properties": {

                "description": "A unique identifier generated by HubSpot that can be used to retrieve and update the pipeline stage."
              },

                "type": "string",
```

## HUBSPOT_UPDATE_PIPELINE_STAGE
Partially updates a HubSpot CRM pipeline stage identified by `objectType`, `pipelineId`, and `stageId`, requiring `metadata` in the request; unspecified fields are unchanged.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdatePipelineStageRequest",
  "required": [
    "objectType",
    "pipelineId",
    "stageId"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "label": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Label",
      "examples": [
        "Appointment Scheduled",
        "Qualified to Buy",
        "Presentation Scheduled"
      ],
      "description": "The display name (label) of the pipeline stage. This label must be unique within the pipeline it belongs to. Omit to leave unchanged.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Label",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter the stage's display name as it should appear in the pipeline. Leave blank to keep the current name."
    },
    "stageId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Stage Id",
      "examples": [
        "12345",
        "closed_won_stage_id",
        "98760"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the pipeline stage to update; must exist within the specified `pipelineId`.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Stage ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Provide the ID of the specific stage to update within the selected pipeline. This ensures we edit the exact stage you intend."
    },
    "archived": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Archived",
      "examples": [
        "true",
        "false"
      ],
      "description": "Set to `true` to archive the pipeline stage, `false` to unarchive. If omitted, its archival status remains unchanged.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Archived",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose whether to archive the stage (hide it from active use) or unarchive it. Leave this blank if you don't want to change its archive status."
    },
    "metadata": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Metadata",
      "examples": [
        "{\"probability\": \"0.5\"}",
        "{\"ticketState\": \"OPEN\"}",
        "{\"ticketState\": \"CLOSED\", \"customKey\": \"customValue\"}",
        "{}"
      ],
      "description": "Stage-specific metadata (key-value string pairs) based on `objectType`. Omit to leave unchanged.\n- For 'deals': If provided, MUST include 'probability' (string '0.0'-'1.0', e.g., '0.7', in '0.1' increments).\n- For 'tickets': Optional 'ticketState' ('OPEN' or 'CLOSED').\n- For other object types, an empty `{}` may be used.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "human_parameter_name": "Metadata",
      "human_parameter_description": "Add the stage details required for your object type (e.g., for deals include a probability like '0.7'; for tickets you can set ticketState to 'OPEN' or 'CLOSED'). Leave blank to keep existing metadata."
    },
    "objectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "deals",
        "tickets",
        "contacts",
        "companies"
      ],
      "description": "Type of CRM object (e.g., 'deals', 'tickets') for the pipeline; must be a valid HubSpot object type that supports pipelines.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Object Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Select the type of HubSpot record this pipeline belongs to (for example, 'deals' or 'tickets'). This determines which pipeline and stages we can update."
    },
    "pipelineId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pipeline Id",
      "examples": [
        "default",
        "sales_pipeline_2024",
        "1234567"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier of the pipeline (specific to the HubSpot account and `objectType`) containing the stage to update; must refer to an existing pipeline.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Pipeline ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "Enter the ID of the pipeline that contains the stage you want to change. This points the update to the correct pipeline in your account."
    },
    "displayOrder": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Display Order",
      "examples": [
        "0",
        "1",
        "10",
        "20"
      ],
      "description": "The display order for this pipeline stage. If multiple stages share the same `displayOrder`, they are sorted alphabetically by `label`. Lower numbers appear first. Omit to leave unchanged.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Display Order",
      "human_parameter_description": "Set the stage's position within the pipeline (lower numbers appear first). Leave blank to keep its current position."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for updating a HubSpot CRM pipeline stage by its ID, pipeline ID, and object type."
}
```

```json
}
```

## HUBSPOT_UPDATE_PRODUCTS
Updates multiple HubSpot products in a single batch operation.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateBatchOfProductsRequest",
  "required": [
    "inputs"
  ],
  "properties": {

              "12345",
              "67890"
            ],
            "description": "The HubSpot Product ID to be updated.",
            "human_parameter_name": "Product ID",
            "human_parameter_description": "The unique ID of the product you want to update in HubSpot. Use the ID from your product record so the correct item is changed."
          },
          "properties": {
            "type": "object",
            "title": "Properties",
            "description": "Properties to update. Only include changes.",
            "additionalProperties": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "human_parameter_description": "Provide only the fields you want to change for this product (for example: name, price, or description). Leave out anything that should stay the same."
          }
        },
        "description": "Individual product update definition for a batch operation."
      },
      "title": "Inputs",
      "description": "List of product update operations.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Product Updates",
      "human_parameter_description": "A list of product updates to apply in one request. Add one item per product, including its Product ID and the properties you want to change."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request to update a batch of products."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_UPDATE_PROPERTY_GROUP
Partially updates a property group's `displayOrder` or `label` for a specified CRM `objectType` in HubSpot.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdatePropertyGroupRequest",
  "required": [
    "objectType",
    "groupName"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "label": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Label",
      "examples": [
        "Contact Information",
        "Deal Details",
        "Company Profile"
      ],
      "description": "Human-readable label for the property group in the UI. If omitted, the current label is unchanged.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Label",
      "human_parameter_description": "The friendly name shown in the app for this property group. Enter a new name if you want to rename the group."
    },
    "groupName": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Group Name",
      "examples": [
        "contactinformation",
        "deal_details",
        "companyprofile"
      ],
      "description": "The unique, case-sensitive internal name of the existing property group to be updated for the specified `objectType`.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Group Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "The internal (case-sensitive) name of the property group you want to change. You can copy this from your CRM\u2019s property settings or from a previous list of groups."
    },
    "objectType": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Type",
      "examples": [
        "contacts",
        "companies",
        "deals",
        "tickets",
        "products",
        "line_items"
      ],
      "description": "The CRM object type (e.g., \"contacts\", \"companies\") for which the property group is updated; must be a valid HubSpot CRM object type.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Object Type",
      "human_parameter_description": "Choose which kind of CRM records this group belongs to, like contacts or companies. This tells the system where to apply your update."
    },
    "displayOrder": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "Display Order",
      "examples": [
        1,
        2,
        -1
      ],
      "description": "Order for displaying the property group: lowest positive integer first, -1 places it after positive values. If omitted, the current order is unchanged.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Display Order",
      "human_parameter_description": "Pick the position where this group should appear in the list. Use a small positive number to move it earlier, or -1 to send it to the end."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for partially updating a CRM property group."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_UPDATE_QUOTE
Performs a partial update on an existing HubSpot quote's specified properties, identifying the quote by `quoteId` (either its internal ID or a custom unique property value if `idProperty` is provided).

**Input schema:**
```json

  "type": "object",

  "required": [
    "quoteId",
    "properties"

      "type": "string",

    },

      "title": "Id Property",
      "description": "Optional. Name of a unique quote property. If provided, `quoteId` is interpreted as this property's value, not the internal object ID.",

    "properties": {
      "type": "object",
      "title": "Properties",
      "examples": [
        {
          "hs_title": "New Quote Title",
          "hs_expiration_date": "2024-12-31"
        }
      ],
      "description": "Properties to update on the quote (internal property names to new values). Only included properties will be updated.",
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": "string"

      "human_parameter_name": "Properties",
      "human_parameter_description": "The fields you want to change on the quote and their new values. Provide a map of internal property names to the values you want to set; only these will be updated."
    }
  },
  "description": "Request schema for `UpdateQuote`"
}
```
