## HUBSPOT_UPDATE_TOKEN_ON_EVENT_TEMPLATE
Updates the label or options of an existing token within a specified HubSpot CRM event template; token name and data type remain unchanged.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateTokenOnEventTemplateRequest",
  "required": [
    "eventTemplateId",
    "tokenName",
    "appId",
    "label"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "appId": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "App Id",
      "examples": [
        "12345",
        "67890"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier (ID) of the application associated with the event template and token.",
      "human_parameter_name": "App ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the HubSpot app that owns the event template. This ensures the update applies to the correct app."
    },
    "label": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Label",
      "examples": [
        "Customer Journey Stage",
        "Lead Status",
        "Service Tier"
      ],
      "description": "New human-readable label for the token, displayed in UIs and used for segmentation/reporting.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Token Label",
      "human_parameter_description": "The new friendly name users will see for this token. Change this to make the token clearer in interfaces and reports."
    },
    "options": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "OptionsRequest",
        "required": [
          "label",
          "value"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "label": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Label",
            "examples": [
              "High Priority",
              "Standard Tier"
            ],
            "description": "The display label for this option. This is what users will see in interfaces.",
            "human_parameter_name": "Display Label",
            "human_parameter_description": "The friendly name people will see for this choice in menus and forms. Enter the text you want displayed to users."
          },
          "value": {
            "type": "string",
            "title": "Value",
            "examples": [
              "HIGH_PRIORITY",
              "STANDARD_TIER"
            ],
            "description": "The internal value stored when this option is selected. This value is used by the system.",
            "human_parameter_description": "A short, stable code that represents this option (for example, HIGH_PRIORITY). This is what the system stores and uses in filters and automations."
          }
        },
        "description": "Represents a single option for an enumeration token, containing a display label and an internal value."
      },
      "title": "Options",
      "description": "List of option objects defining selectable choices, applicable only if the token's type is 'enumeration'. Required to modify options for an enumeration type token.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Options",
      "human_parameter_description": "Provide the list of selectable choices for this token when it's an enumeration. Use this to add, remove, or rename the options users can pick."
    },
    "tokenName": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Token Name",
      "examples": [
        "petType",
        "follow_up_reason"
      ],
      "description": "Name of the token to update within the specified event template; must match an existing token's name.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Token Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "The exact name of the token you want to modify in that template. It must match an existing token name."
    },
    "eventTemplateId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Event Template Id",
      "examples": [
        "1234abcd-5678-efgh-ijkl-9012mnop3456"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier (ID) of the event template containing the token to update.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Event Template ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the event template you want to update. You can copy this from the template's details page."
    },
    "objectPropertyName": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Object Property Name",
      "examples": [
        "hs_lead_status",
        "company_annual_revenue",
        "contact_source"
      ],
      "description": "Name of the CRM object property this token populates, linking its value to a CRM object property. If null, no direct mapping.",
      "human_parameter_name": "Object Property Name",
      "human_parameter_description": "If you want this token to fill a CRM property, enter that property's name. Leave blank if you don't want to map it to a property."
    }
  },
  "description": "Defines the parameters required to update an existing token on an event template."
}
```

## HUBSPOT_UPDATE_VIDEO_CONFERENCE_APP_SETTINGS
Updates webhook URLs (for creating/updating/deleting meetings, fetching accounts, verifying users) for a video conference application specified by `appId`. Requires developer API key authentication. All URLs must use HTTPS protocol and be publicly accessible.

**Input schema:**
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "title": "UpdateVideoConferenceAppSettingsRequest",
  "required": [
    "appId",
    "createMeetingUrl"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "appId": {
      "type": "integer",
      "title": "App Id",
      "examples": [
        "12345"
      ],
      "description": "Unique identifier for the video conference application in HubSpot, assigned upon creation in the developer portal. Example: 12345.",
      "human_parameter_name": "App ID",
      "human_parameter_description": "The ID of the video conferencing app you want to update in HubSpot. Find this in your developer portal for the app you created."
    },
    "userVerifyUrl": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "User Verify Url",
      "description": "URL HubSpot uses to verify a user's existence and authentication with the video conference app, confirming identity before certain actions.",
      "human_parameter_name": "User Verification URL",
      "human_parameter_description": "A link in your service that confirms a user exists and is signed in. HubSpot calls this to verify users before allowing actions."
    },
    "createMeetingUrl": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Create Meeting Url",
```
